Your quote identifies the items included for your property and any exclusions; not every repair needs every task.Work items to compare in a written quotationWork itemDetail to confirmInspection and accessAccessible checks, concealed areas and any agreed opening or further visit.RemovalTiles, bedding, fittings and old waterproofing to remove, with demolition limits.Substrate and fallsPreparation, repairs, replacement, drainage falls and floor-level changes.Membrane detailsSelected system, coverage, junctions, penetrations, drains and thresholds.Curing and testingProduct requirements, agreed checks and release before covering.Tile supply and layingSupplier, quantity, size, thickness, adhesive, laying, grout and edges.Flexible jointsLocations, suitable sealant and connection with adjoining finishes.ReinstatementFixtures, screens, trims and fittings to refit or replace.Waste and protectionDebris removal, protection of other rooms or common areas and cleaning.Related tradesPlumbing, electrical or other tasks, responsible provider and inclusion in the total.Where a selection is open, ask how its amount will be confirmed. A quote that includes tile supply cannot be compared directly with one that assumes you will purchase every tile. Concealed repairs and fixture selections need equally clear treatment.Shower-only work and full bathroom renewalA shower-only repair may be feasible, but its boundary needs assessment. The scope must address the substrate, adjoining waterproofing and how the repaired area connects to surrounding construction. Keeping the rest of the bathroom can affect access and reinstatement; the smaller visible area does not establish that the underlying detail is straightforward.Tell MEL ONE which bath, vanity, screen, tiles or fittings you want to keep. Ask whether removal can affect them and who handles replacement if they cannot be reused. Where the assessment supports a broader scope, request an explanation of the condition or connection that makes that work necessary.A full bathroom proposal should show the finished outcome as well as the membrane stage. Confirm the extent of wall and floor tiling, edges, flexible joints and any plumbing changes. For a laundry renovation, apply the same scope checklist while identifying appliance connections and the agreed handover between trades. The quote should describe the actual room and layout.Owner-supplied tiles and finish selectionsIf you have already bought tiles for an ensuite or bathroom, share their product information, dimensions, thickness and available quantity. The team needs to review suitability, layout, preparation and installation compatibility before including them. A box count alone does not establish whether there is enough material for the proposed layout and cuts.Ask who checks quantities, arranges delivery, stores the tiles and supplies any additional material. Identify trims and edge details as well as the main tile. If more tiles are needed, availability and batch or appearance differences may affect the finish, so resolve that selection before laying wherever possible.You do not need to select tiles before first contact. MEL ONE can assess the site and discuss tile supply and selections as part of confirming the written scope. Distinguish the cost of supplying tiles from laying, adhesive, grout and flexible joints, even when those items appear together in the final proposal. This makes comparison and later changes easier to understand.Concealed waterproofing conditions and written approval for changesAccessible checks cannot reveal every concealed condition. MEL ONE checks the visible tile layers, substrate and earlier repairs on site, then agrees the access needed to investigate further. If removal is needed before the full condition can be known, the quotation should explain that limit and the initial work you are authorising.If opening the area exposes damage or a drainage issue, use a clear variation sequence: explain the finding, describe the additional preparation or trade work, set out its cost and timing effect, then obtain written approval before proceeding with the additional scope. Keep that update with the original quote. A changed project should not be judged against an outdated list of inclusions.Name the person who can approve changes, particularly for a rental or strata property. Agree how findings and photographs will be shared if that person is away. This helps prevent a pause on site becoming a rushed decision made by someone without authority to approve the work.Membrane curing, inspections and readiness for tilingThe quote should name the selected system and the handover point before it is covered. Substrate condition, junctions and drainage details need attention as part of the construction. Ask which inspections or tests are included, who carries them out and how readiness for the next stage will be recorded.Product instructions distinguish stages that can have different waiting requirements. The ARDEX WPM 002 datasheet, for example, gives separate guidance for tiling, curing and flood testing, and explains that temperature affects drying and curing. It also identifies details that may dry more slowly. This illustrates why a generic promise about the next day is inadequate; it does not specify the product for your job.Weather and site conditions can affect the agreed sequence. Where testing is specified, it must suit the selected product and project. Do not fill a suspect bathroom or balcony to trial a flood test yourself. Agree how completed waterproofing will be protected from damage or later penetrations before other trades return.Bathroom downtime in occupied homes, rentals and strataConfirm room downtime before scheduling work: which facilities become unavailable, when removal starts, and which preparation, curing, testing and finishing steps must be complete before use resumes. Time spent applying a product is only one part of the period during which a room may be unavailable.If this is your only bathroom, raise that at the first discussion. Ask whether the toilet, basin and shower will all be affected and plan alternative washing arrangements around the confirmed sequence. Do not assume keeping one fixture in place means residents can safely use it throughout the work.For an occupied rental, agree entry, resident communication and the approval contact with the property manager. For an apartment, include lift bookings, permitted work hours, common-area protection and relevant strata arrangements. Give MEL ONE your suburb, floor level, parking and entry details. Ask how a delayed stage will be communicated so residents can adjust their arrangements without relying on an unconfirmed return date.Waterproofing handover records and project-specific requirementsRequest a handover record identifying the area treated, agreed materials, relevant photographs, included inspection or test records, care instructions and the point at which normal use can resume. List remaining reinstatement tasks and who is responsible for completing them. Keep the record with the quotation and approved variations for future maintenance.The ABCB FAQ directs existing-building alterations to state or territory rules. Confirm the requirements for the ACT project and who provides any required documentation. A request for useful completion records should not be treated as a promise that a particular certificate will be supplied.For an enquiry, provide the property type, affected room, symptoms, previous repairs and the finishes you hope to retain. Photos are optional; measurements are not required before first contact. Request a waterproofing and retiling scope with your suburb and a short description. The Ellis team checks the site, explains the findings and confirms the repair plan and written quote.Related waterproofing questionsCan I compare waterproofing quotes using the total alone?Compare the same removal, preparation, materials, finishes, related trades and reinstatement first. A membrane-only amount can exclude work needed to return the room to use. Ask each provider to identify inclusions, exclusions and conditions awaiting inspection.Can I use tiles I have already bought?Share the tile specifications, size, thickness and available quantity. Suitability and the installation scope need review before owner-supplied tiles are included. Confirm responsibility for additional tiles, delivery, trims and any changes to preparation or laying.How long will my only bathroom be unavailable?The period depends on the agreed work, selected products and site conditions. Confirm which facilities are affected, the sequence and the return-to-use requirements before booking. Arrange alternative facilities around that plan and agree how any changes will be communicated.Related waterproofing services and projectsServicesProjectsRequest assessmentRelated waterproofing and leak repair servicesbathroom waterproofing · balcony waterproofing · laundry waterproofingShower Regrouting, Resealing and Rewaterproofing in Canberra · Balcony Waterproofing in Canberra for Leaks Into the Room Below · Shower Plumbing Leaks and Waterproofing Failure in CanberraFor a property in Belconnen, Gungahlin, Woden Valley or elsewhere in the ACT, book a waterproofing assessment or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them. pages.title: 堪培拉浴室防水和重铺瓷砖报价
pages.summary: 应围绕相同的维修目标，比较拆除、准备、防水和恢复施工的内容。照片、尺寸和瓷砖选型可以在首次联系之后再确认。
pages.body_html:
MEL ONE 防水指南

堪培拉浴室防水和重铺瓷砖报价

应围绕相同的维修目标，比较拆除、准备、防水和恢复施工的内容。照片、尺寸和瓷砖选型可以在首次联系之后再确认。

浴室防水与重新铺砖

我们会现场检查受影响区域，说明合适的维修工作，并确认书面报价。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

由 MEL ONE · 更新 2026 年 10 月 14 日

防水报价策划

首次联系前无需先测量或拍照，也不必备齐所有资料才能咨询维修或施工。瓷砖也可以稍后选择，欢迎先联系 MEL ONE。

我们现场评估浴室，并在书面报价中列明约定工作：检查、拆除、基层与排水坡度处理、防水层细节、固化及约定测试、瓷砖供应与铺贴、柔性接缝、恢复施工、废料清运与相关工种。我们区分包含项、不包含项及仍需检查后确认的内容，按现场情况和您希望的饰面安排施工。先比较范围，再比较总价：仅包含防水层施工的报价与整间浴室重建并非同一项工程。

类似的防水和重铺范围

比较报价时，向各施工方提供相同需求：受影响的淋浴间、浴室或阳台、问题现象，以及希望保留的配件与饰面。请各方区分包含、不包含和需检查后确定的工作；只有“防水与铺砖”几个字，无法看出拆除、供砖和恢复使用的具体安排。

局部重新密封报价应说明可处理接缝及准备工作；更新防水层则需说明如何拆开、更换并恢复覆盖。完整的防水与铺砖范围还应衔接最终饰面和恢复施工。比较时应围绕同一个维修目标。

我们的 重新填缝、重新密封或重新防水指南 解释了这些修复边界。对于湿区更新，请参阅 浴室防水和重铺瓷砖。外部排水、门槛和通道也会影响 阳台防水范围.

防水修补的区别

本指南中精选的区别
考虑因素评估的起点
可比范围根据相同的修复目标比较拆除、准备、防水和恢复。标记包含、排除和依赖于检查的工作。
淋浴或整个浴室仅淋浴的工作需要与保留结构良好连接。全面的浴室更新还需要明确的饰面、配件和修复。
隐蔽条件从外部检查无法揭示所有隐蔽缺陷。应说明检查范围，并在增加工作、费用或时间安排前取得书面批准。

阅读对应章节，了解维修选择、材料和施工准备。

防水和重铺报价包含内容

我们按以下项目界定防水与重新铺砖的施工范围。您的报价会列明实际包含项和不包含项，并非每次维修都需要全部项目。

书面报价中要比较的工作项目
工作项目详情待确认
检查与进场条件可检查的部位、隐蔽区域，以及约定的拆检或再次上门。
去除需要拆除的瓷砖、铺贴找平层、配件和旧防水层，以及拆除范围。
基层与排水坡度基层处理、修补或更换、排水坡度及地面标高调整。
防水层细节所选系统、施工区域、接缝、穿管部位、地漏和门槛细节。
固化和测试产品要求、商定的检查和覆盖前放行。
瓷砖供应及铺设供应商、数量、尺寸、厚度、粘合剂、铺设、填缝和边缘。
柔性接缝位置、合适的密封剂以及与相邻饰面的连接。
恢复施工需要重新安装或更换的器具、淋浴屏风、收边条及配件。
废料清运与现场保护清除杂物、保护其他房间或公共区域并进行清洁。
相关专业工种水管、电气或其他工作、对应负责人，以及是否计入总价。

尚未确定的选型，应确认费用如何核定。包含瓷砖供应的报价，不能直接与由您自行购砖的报价相比。隐蔽部位维修及配件选择也应同样说明。

仅淋浴工作和全面的浴室更新

有些情况可只维修淋浴间，但需检查范围边界、基层、相邻防水层及新旧构造连接。保留浴室其他部分会影响拆检与恢复；可见损坏面积小，不表示下方构造一定容易处理。

请告诉 MEL ONE 希望保留哪些浴缸、浴室柜、淋浴屏风、瓷砖或配件，并确认拆除会否影响它们，以及不能重用时由谁负责更换。如建议扩大施工范围，应说明相应的基层状况或连接要求。

整间浴室方案应说明完工效果和防水层工序，确认墙地铺砖、收边、柔性接缝及水管改动范围。洗衣房翻新可用相同清单核对，但需按实际房间布局明确家电连接及各工种交接。

业主提供的瓷砖和饰面选择

如果您已经购买了套间或浴室的瓷砖，请分享其产品信息、尺寸、厚度和可用数量。团队需要在纳入它们之前审查适用性、布局、准备和安装兼容性。仅凭盒子计数并不能确定是否有足够的材料用于建议的布局和裁剪。

请确认谁核对用量、安排送货和存放瓷砖，以及补充材料；收边条及边缘做法也应一并确定。如需补砖，供货情况、批次或外观差异可能影响效果，宜尽可能在铺贴前解决。

首次联系前不必先选好瓷砖。MEL ONE 可在现场评估和确认书面范围时，与您讨论瓷砖供应及选型。瓷砖供应、铺贴、粘接材料、填缝和柔性接缝的费用应分别说明，即使它们列在同一份方案中，也便于比较及处理后续变更。

隐蔽防水条件及变更书面批准

可接触部位的检查无法揭示所有隐蔽状况。我们先查看可见的瓷砖层、基层及以往维修，再约定进一步拆检方式。如需拆除后才能了解完整情况，报价会说明这一限制，以及您本次批准的初步工作。

如拆开后发现损坏或排水问题，应说明发现、拟增加的准备或工种工作、费用及工期影响，并在增加施工范围前取得书面批准。将更新与原报价一并保存，后续按已批准的新范围核对。

请明确谁有权批准变更，出租或分层产权物业尤其需要提前确认，并约定负责人不在场时如何传递检查结果及照片，避免让无权批准的人仓促作决定。

防水层固化、检查及铺砖条件

报价应列明所选系统，以及覆盖前的检查交接点。基层、接缝和排水细节都属于施工考虑范围。应确认包含哪些检查或测试、由谁执行，以及如何记录下一工序开始前的条件。

产品说明区分可能有不同等待要求的阶段。的 ARDEX WPM 002 数据表例如，对瓷砖、固化和洪水测试给出了单独的指导，并解释了温度影响干燥和固化。它还可以识别干燥速度较慢的细节。这说明了为什么对第二天的一般承诺是不够的；它没有指定适合您工作的产品。

天气和现场条件可能影响约定施工顺序。需要测试时，应按所选产品及项目要求进行，不要自行向疑似漏水的浴室或阳台灌水测试。其他工种进场前，应约定如何保护已完成的防水层，防止损坏或后续穿孔。

自住房、出租房及分层产权物业的浴室停用安排

排期前应确认浴室停用安排：哪些设施不可用、何时拆除，以及恢复使用前须完成哪些准备、养护、测试和收尾。涂刷材料的时间只是整个停用期的一部分。

家中只有一间浴室，请在首次沟通时说明，并确认马桶、面盆和淋浴是否受影响，按施工顺序安排临时洗浴。保留某件器具，不代表施工期间仍可安全使用。

有人居住的出租物业，应与物业经理约定进场、住户沟通及批准联系人。公寓还需考虑电梯预约、允许施工时段、公共区域保护和分层产权安排。请向 MEL ONE 提供区域、楼层、停车及入口信息，并约定延期时如何通知，避免依赖未确认的恢复使用日期。

防水交接记录及具体工程要求

请确认交接记录，包括处理区域、约定材料、相关照片、本次包含的检查或测试记录、保养说明及恢复使用时间。剩余恢复工作及负责人也应列明，与报价和已批准变更一并保存，供日后维护参考。

的 ABCB常见问题解答 根据州或地区的规则指导现有建筑的改造。确认 ACT 项目的要求以及谁提供所需的文档。对有用的完成记录的请求不应被视为将提供特定证书的承诺。

如需咨询，请提供房产类型、受影响的房间、症状、之前的维修以及您希望保留的饰面。照片是可选的；首次接触前不需要进行测量。 请求防水和重铺范围 包含您所在的郊区和简短的描述。Ellis团队检查现场，解释调查结果并确认维修计划和书面报价。

相关防水问题

可以只比较总价来选择防水报价吗？

先比较相同的拆除、准备、材料、饰面、相关工种和恢复施工。仅包含防水层施工的报价，可能不包含让房间恢复使用所需的其他工作。每份报价都应明确包含项、不包含项和需现场检查的条件。

我可以使用已经购买的瓷砖吗？

分享瓷砖规格、尺寸、厚度和可用数量。在包括业主提供的瓷砖之前，需要审查适用性和安装范围。确认额外瓷砖、交付、装饰以及任何准备或铺设变更的责任。

我唯一的浴室将在多长时间内无法使用？

周期取决于商定的工作、所选产品和现场条件。在预约前确认哪些设施受到影响、顺序以及恢复使用的要求。围绕该计划安排替代设施，并商定如何传达任何变更。

阳台防水范围.防水修补的区别本指南中精选的区别考虑因素评估的起点可比范围根据相同的修复目标比较拆除、准备、防水和恢复。标记包含、排除和依赖于检查的工作。淋浴或整个浴室仅淋浴的工作需要与保留结构良好连接。全面的浴室更新还需要明确的饰面、配件和修复。隐蔽条件从外部检查无法揭示所有隐蔽缺陷。应说明检查范围，并在增加工作、费用或时间安排前取得书面批准。阅读对应章节，了解维修选择、材料和施工准备。防水和重铺报价包含内容我们按以下项目界定防水与重新铺砖的施工范围。您的报价会列明实际包含项和不包含项，并非每次维修都需要全部项目。书面报价中要比较的工作项目工作项目详情待确认检查与进场条件可检查的部位、隐蔽区域，以及约定的拆检或再次上门。去除需要拆除的瓷砖、铺贴找平层、配件和旧防水层，以及拆除范围。基层与排水坡度基层处理、修补或更换、排水坡度及地面标高调整。防水层细节所选系统、施工区域、接缝、穿管部位、地漏和门槛细节。固化和测试产品要求、商定的检查和覆盖前放行。瓷砖供应及铺设供应商、数量、尺寸、厚度、粘合剂、铺设、填缝和边缘。柔性接缝位置、合适的密封剂以及与相邻饰面的连接。恢复施工需要重新安装或更换的器具、淋浴屏风、收边条及配件。废料清运与现场保护清除杂物、保护其他房间或公共区域并进行清洁。相关专业工种水管、电气或其他工作、对应负责人，以及是否计入总价。尚未确定的选型，应确认费用如何核定。包含瓷砖供应的报价，不能直接与由您自行购砖的报价相比。隐蔽部位维修及配件选择也应同样说明。仅淋浴工作和全面的浴室更新有些情况可只维修淋浴间，但需检查范围边界、基层、相邻防水层及新旧构造连接。保留浴室其他部分会影响拆检与恢复；可见损坏面积小，不表示下方构造一定容易处理。请告诉 MEL ONE 希望保留哪些浴缸、浴室柜、淋浴屏风、瓷砖或配件，并确认拆除会否影响它们，以及不能重用时由谁负责更换。如建议扩大施工范围，应说明相应的基层状况或连接要求。整间浴室方案应说明完工效果和防水层工序，确认墙地铺砖、收边、柔性接缝及水管改动范围。洗衣房翻新可用相同清单核对，但需按实际房间布局明确家电连接及各工种交接。业主提供的瓷砖和饰面选择如果您已经购买了套间或浴室的瓷砖，请分享其产品信息、尺寸、厚度和可用数量。团队需要在纳入它们之前审查适用性、布局、准备和安装兼容性。仅凭盒子计数并不能确定是否有足够的材料用于建议的布局和裁剪。请确认谁核对用量、安排送货和存放瓷砖，以及补充材料；收边条及边缘做法也应一并确定。如需补砖，供货情况、批次或外观差异可能影响效果，宜尽可能在铺贴前解决。首次联系前不必先选好瓷砖。MEL ONE 可在现场评估和确认书面范围时，与您讨论瓷砖供应及选型。瓷砖供应、铺贴、粘接材料、填缝和柔性接缝的费用应分别说明，即使它们列在同一份方案中，也便于比较及处理后续变更。隐蔽防水条件及变更书面批准可接触部位的检查无法揭示所有隐蔽状况。我们先查看可见的瓷砖层、基层及以往维修，再约定进一步拆检方式。如需拆除后才能了解完整情况，报价会说明这一限制，以及您本次批准的初步工作。如拆开后发现损坏或排水问题，应说明发现、拟增加的准备或工种工作、费用及工期影响，并在增加施工范围前取得书面批准。将更新与原报价一并保存，后续按已批准的新范围核对。请明确谁有权批准变更，出租或分层产权物业尤其需要提前确认，并约定负责人不在场时如何传递检查结果及照片，避免让无权批准的人仓促作决定。防水层固化、检查及铺砖条件报价应列明所选系统，以及覆盖前的检查交接点。基层、接缝和排水细节都属于施工考虑范围。应确认包含哪些检查或测试、由谁执行，以及如何记录下一工序开始前的条件。产品说明区分可能有不同等待要求的阶段。的 ARDEX WPM 002 数据表例如，对瓷砖、固化和洪水测试给出了单独的指导，并解释了温度影响干燥和固化。它还可以识别干燥速度较慢的细节。这说明了为什么对第二天的一般承诺是不够的；它没有指定适合您工作的产品。天气和现场条件可能影响约定施工顺序。需要测试时，应按所选产品及项目要求进行，不要自行向疑似漏水的浴室或阳台灌水测试。其他工种进场前，应约定如何保护已完成的防水层，防止损坏或后续穿孔。自住房、出租房及分层产权物业的浴室停用安排排期前应确认浴室停用安排：哪些设施不可用、何时拆除，以及恢复使用前须完成哪些准备、养护、测试和收尾。涂刷材料的时间只是整个停用期的一部分。家中只有一间浴室，请在首次沟通时说明，并确认马桶、面盆和淋浴是否受影响，按施工顺序安排临时洗浴。保留某件器具，不代表施工期间仍可安全使用。有人居住的出租物业，应与物业经理约定进场、住户沟通及批准联系人。公寓还需考虑电梯预约、允许施工时段、公共区域保护和分层产权安排。请向 MEL ONE 提供区域、楼层、停车及入口信息，并约定延期时如何通知，避免依赖未确认的恢复使用日期。防水交接记录及具体工程要求请确认交接记录，包括处理区域、约定材料、相关照片、本次包含的检查或测试记录、保养说明及恢复使用时间。剩余恢复工作及负责人也应列明，与报价和已批准变更一并保存，供日后维护参考。的 ABCB常见问题解答 根据州或地区的规则指导现有建筑的改造。确认 ACT 项目的要求以及谁提供所需的文档。对有用的完成记录的请求不应被视为将提供特定证书的承诺。如需咨询，请提供房产类型、受影响的房间、症状、之前的维修以及您希望保留的饰面。照片是可选的；首次接触前不需要进行测量。 请求防水和重铺范围 包含您所在的郊区和简短的描述。Ellis团队检查现场，解释调查结果并确认维修计划和书面报价。相关防水问题可以只比较总价来选择防水报价吗？先比较相同的拆除、准备、材料、饰面、相关工种和恢复施工。仅包含防水层施工的报价，可能不包含让房间恢复使用所需的其他工作。每份报价都应明确包含项、不包含项和需现场检查的条件。我可以使用已经购买的瓷砖吗？分享瓷砖规格、尺寸、厚度和可用数量。在包括业主提供的瓷砖之前，需要审查适用性和安装范围。确认额外瓷砖、交付、装饰以及任何准备或铺设变更的责任。我唯一的浴室将在多长时间内无法使用？周期取决于商定的工作、所选产品和现场条件。在预约前确认哪些设施受到影响、顺序以及恢复使用的要求。围绕该计划安排替代设施，并商定如何传达任何变更。相关防水服务与施工案例服务项目施工案例预约现场评估相关防水补漏服务浴室防水 pages.title: Canberra Waterproofing and Wet Weather Preparation
pages.summary: A practical waterproofing checklist for spotting visible water entry, recording wet-weather patterns and arranging the right inspection.
pages.body_html:
MEL ONE waterproofing update

Canberra Waterproofing and Wet Weather Preparation

A practical waterproofing checklist for spotting visible water entry, recording wet-weather patterns and arranging the right inspection.

Roof waterproofing & leak repairs · External waterproofing & water ingress repairs

We inspect the affected area, explain the appropriate repair work and confirm a written quote.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

Waterproofing and drainage checks before rain

Before rain arrives, look at the areas you can safely reach from the ground: visible gutters and downpipes, balcony edges, door thresholds, external wall junctions and marks on ceilings or walls. Note where water appears, how long it lasts and whether the pattern follows wind-driven rain. These observations help the Ellis team understand the service request; they do not identify a concealed defect by themselves.

Safe records of roof and wall leaks

Photograph visible staining from inside and the corresponding external area only when it is safely accessible. Do not climb onto a wet roof, ladder or unstable surface. Record the date, recent weather, affected room and any change in the size or colour of the mark. Keep belongings clear of active drips and contact the appropriate emergency service if there is an immediate electrical or structural hazard.

Rain leak causes and suitable repair trades

No single repair method fits every water-entry path. Roof coverings, flashings, plumbing, drainage and waterproofed balconies are different systems. A Canberra roof leak assessment should identify the accessible source and define whether the work concerns roof repair, external waterproofing or another trade. For tiled balconies, the scope may include inspection, removal, membrane replacement and retiling where access is required.

Information for a waterproofing inspection

Share your suburb, affected area, when the water appears and clear photographs taken from safe positions. The Ellis team carries out the agreed work directly and explains the inspection findings, inclusions and quote before work begins. For urgent Canberra jobs, on-site attendance may be available in as little as 30 minutes after contact, subject to current availability, address and safe access.

For roof leak and waterproofing service, external water-ingress repairs or a property-specific Canberra waterproofing assessment, contact MEL ONE with the location and observed symptoms.

Leaks that appear only in wind-driven rain

An intermittent leak still needs a clear record. Note when rain starts, which direction it reaches the building from if known, and when the indoor mark or drip appears. A roof-to-wall junction, window perimeter and balcony threshold present different inspection questions. We use the reported pattern to plan the accessible waterproofing assessment, rather than assuming the stain sits directly below the entry point. Share previous repair records as well as current photographs.

Balcony ponding after the outlet is cleared

If water still collects or appears in the room below, record the ponding position and how long it remains. An outlet, the falls towards it, tiled joints and the concealed membrane are separate details. Clearing an outlet does not by itself establish which repair is needed. Compare the existing balcony leak guide with the inspection findings before choosing local sealing or a scope that opens the tiled area for membrane replacement and reinstatement.

Lingering dampness and the next repair trade

A surface that looks dry is not proof that the layers behind it are ready for painting or reinstatement. Record recurring odours, stains and any change after rain for the assessment. Waterproofing, specialist drying, mould treatment and ceiling repairs are different scopes. Confirm who will check the affected materials and arrange any separate work before covering the damage. Our existing FAQ explains rain-related symptoms and the limits of surface repairs.

pages.body_html:
MEL ONE 防水更新

堪培拉防水和潮湿天气准备

实用的防水检查表，用于发现可见的进水情况、记录潮湿天气模式并安排正确的检查。

屋顶防水与漏水维修 · 外部防水与渗水维修

我们会现场检查受影响区域，说明合适的维修工作，并确认书面报价。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

雨前防水、排水检查

下雨前，可从地面安全位置观察天沟、落水管、阳台边缘、门槛、外墙接缝及室内天花板或墙面的水渍。记录水何时出现、持续多久，以及是否与特定风向的降雨有关。这些信息有助于我们了解需求，但不能单凭观察确认隐蔽缺陷。

屋顶和墙壁渗漏的安全记录

可拍摄室内水渍；对应的室外部位只在能够安全接近时拍摄。不要爬上湿滑屋顶、梯子或不稳的表面。记录日期、近期天气、受影响房间及水渍大小或颜色变化，将物品移离正在滴水的位置。如存在即时电气或结构危险，请联系相应紧急服务。

雨水渗漏原因与相关维修工种

不同进水路径需要不同维修。屋面覆盖物、泛水板、水管、排水和阳台防水属于不同系统；屋顶漏水检查应判断可接触的来源，再确定是屋面、防水还是其他工种的工作。铺砖阳台如需拆开处理，范围可能包括检查、拆除、防水层更换及重新铺砖。

防水检查信息

请提供所在区域、受影响部位、出现水的时间，以及从安全位置拍摄的照片。Ellis 团队直接完成约定工作，并在施工前说明检查结果、包含项和报价。堪培拉紧急工作联系后最快30分钟可到场，具体取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

对于 屋顶漏水和防水服务, 外部进水维修 或特定属性 堪培拉防水评估，请联系 MEL ONE，说明位置及已观察到的情况。

只在风雨交加时出现的渗漏

间歇性渗漏也需要清晰记录。请记下开始下雨的时间、已知的迎雨方向，以及室内出现水渍或滴水的时间。屋面与墙体交接处、窗周和阳台门槛需要考虑的检查问题各不相同。我们会依据这些规律安排可进行的防水检查，不会仅凭水渍位置就认定进水点在正上方。咨询时也请提供以往维修记录和当前照片。

阳台排水口清理后仍有积水

如果阳台仍积水或楼下房间出现潮湿，请记录积水位置与持续时间。排水口、通向排水口的坡度、瓷砖接缝和隐蔽防水层是不同的构造。仅清理排水口，无法判断下一步该如何维修。可结合本站阳台漏水指南与现场检查结果，再比较局部密封和拆开瓷砖更换防水层、恢复饰面的方案。

持续潮湿与后续维修工种

表面看起来干燥，并不代表其背后的材料已经适合油漆或恢复饰面。请记录反复出现的气味、水渍及雨后的变化，供评估参考。防水、专业干燥、除霉和天花板维修是不同的施工范围。覆盖受损部位之前，应确认由谁检查材料状况及安排其他工程。本站 FAQ 也说明了雨后渗漏症状与表面维修的局限。

pages.summary: A plain-English guide to the inspection, preparation, waterproofing, retiling and exclusions to check in a repair quote.
pages.body_html:
MEL ONE waterproofing update

Canberra Waterproofing Repair Quote Inclusions

A plain-English guide to the inspection, preparation, waterproofing, retiling and exclusions to check in a repair quote.

We inspect the affected area, explain the appropriate repair work and confirm a written quote.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

Waterproofing repair quote inclusions

Our waterproofing quote lists the work needed for your property, including the agreed inspection, access, removal, preparation, membrane installation and finishing items. We distinguish included work from exclusions, such as separate plumbing or drainage tasks, before you approve the repair. Curing and the work sequence are confirmed for the selected system.

Comparing waterproofing and leak repair quotes

Compare the scope, not only the headline price. Check that each quote describes a similar area, access method, materials, preparation and reinstatement. Ask what is included if damaged substrate is uncovered, how variations are approved and whether fixtures need to be removed. A quote for local shower resealing is not the same scope as removing tiles and replacing a concealed membrane.

Plumbing, roof, drainage and waterproofing repair boundaries

We identify the water path and separate waterproofing from plumbing, roof-covering and stormwater-drainage work. Your quote identifies any other licensed trade needed, so a joint repair or membrane renewal is not mistaken for a pipe or drainage repair.

Waterproofing repair team and agreed scope

We carry out the agreed MEL ONE work directly. Before starting, we confirm the inclusions, access requirements, sequence, quote validity and exclusions in writing. We explain how the proposed method addresses the affected area and reported symptoms, including any concealed conditions that need further access before the repair can be confirmed.

For bathroom waterproofing and retiling, shower resealing and regrouting, or external water-ingress repairs, contact MEL ONE to discuss an on-site inspection and written waterproofing quote.

Comparing quotes for a leak that follows rain

Ask whether the price covers an inspection, a defined repair, or both. Compare the affected area, safe access, removal, preparation, selected waterproofing system, reinstatement and any return visit actually included. A proposal to reseal an accessible joint differs from removing tiles to repair a balcony membrane. If the entry point remains concealed, the quote should explain the investigation allowed for and how further findings or changes will be approved before extra work.

Keep leak records separate from insurance decisions

Keep dated photographs taken safely, the location and timing of the leak, previous maintenance records, the inspection findings and the agreed repair scope together. These records help explain what was observed and repaired. Ask your insurer what information it requires and whether any work needs prior approval. A waterproofing quote is not a decision about the cause of an insured event, policy coverage or payment; do not delay urgent safety assistance to collect documents.

pages.body_html:
MEL ONE 防水更新

堪培拉防水维修报价包含内容

有关检查、准备、防水、重新贴砖和排除事项的简明英语指南，用于检查维修报价。

我们会现场检查受影响区域，说明合适的维修工作，并确认书面报价。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

防水维修报价包含内容

我们的防水报价列明您物业所需的工作，包括约定的检查、进场、拆除、基层处理、防水层施工和收尾项目。维修获批前，我们区分包含项与不包含项，例如单独的水管或排水任务，并按所选系统确认固化要求和施工顺序。

防水和漏水修复报价比较

比较报价时，不只看总价，还要核对施工区域、进场方式、材料、基层处理及恢复项目是否相当。确认拆开后若发现基层损坏如何处理、变更怎样批准，以及是否需要拆卸配件。局部淋浴间重新密封，与拆砖更换隐蔽防水层并不是同一项工程。

管道、屋顶、排水和防水修复边界

我们检查进水路径，将防水与水管、屋面覆盖及雨水排水工作区分。报价会列明需要的其他持牌工种，避免把接缝维修或防水层更新误当成管道、排水维修。

防水维修队伍及约定范围

我们直接完成约定的 MEL ONE 工作。施工前，我们书面确认包含项、进场要求、施工顺序、报价有效期和不包含的项目，并解释拟用方法如何处理受影响部位与已报告的症状；如隐蔽部位需要进一步拆检才能确认维修，也会说明。

对于 浴室防水和重铺瓷砖, 淋浴重新密封和重新填缝, 或 外部进水维修，联系 MEL ONE 讨论现场检查和书面防水报价。

比较雨后渗漏维修报价

请先确认价格涵盖检查、已确定的维修，还是两者都有。比较受影响部位、安全进场、拆除、基层处理、所选防水系统、饰面恢复及实际包含的回访。重新密封可见接缝，与拆除瓷砖维修阳台防水层，是不同的方案。如果进水点仍在隐蔽部位，报价应说明已计入哪些排查，以及进一步发现问题或调整范围时，如何在追加施工前取得同意。

区分漏水维修记录与保险决定

请将安全拍摄并注明日期的照片、漏水位置及时间、以往维护记录、检查结果和约定维修范围一并保存，便于说明发现的问题及已完成的维修。请向保险公司确认所需资料，以及相关工程是否需事先同意。防水报价不等于对保险事故成因、承保范围或赔付的认定；不要为了收集文件而延误紧急安全协助。

pages.summary: Learn which safe, clear photos help the Ellis team prepare for a waterproofing inspection and written repair quote.
pages.body_html:
MEL ONE waterproofing update

Photos for a Canberra Waterproofing Quote

Learn which safe, clear photos help the Ellis team prepare for a waterproofing inspection and written repair quote.

We inspect the affected area, explain the appropriate repair work and confirm a written quote.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

Useful photos for a waterproofing quote

Take one wide photo showing the affected room or exterior area, then closer photos of visible stains, cracked grout, failed silicone, lifted tiles or the wall-floor junction. Include a reference point so the location is clear. For a bathroom leak, show the shower, screen, floor, adjacent wall and any affected room on the other side if safely accessible. For a balcony leak, include the door threshold, perimeter and visible area below.

Safe leak photography

Use steady, well-lit images and avoid filters. Photograph the area when the symptom is visible, then note the date and whether it followed shower use, rain or another event. Do not remove tiles, cut sealant, enter a ceiling space or climb onto a roof to get a better view. A photo documents an observation; it cannot confirm the concealed water path or replace an on-site assessment.

Waterproofing repair details to send with photos

Include your suburb, the room or external area affected, when the water appears, how long the issue has been occurring and any previous repair that you know about. Mention whether the property is occupied and any access constraints. Avoid sending personal documents, faces, house numbers or unrelated private details. The Ellis team uses this information to prepare for a focused inspection and discuss the next step.

Photo assessment and waterproofing repair pricing

Photos can support an initial conversation, but concealed conditions, access, demolition and reinstatement can change the work scope. A written quote should identify the observed issue, included preparation, waterproofing or sealing work, retiling if required, exclusions and any related trade coordination. Plumbing faults and drainage repairs may need a separate trade scope.

See the relevant MEL ONE services for leaking shower repairs, bathroom waterproofing and retiling, or balcony waterproofing. Email optional, safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au and use the Canberra waterproofing service form to arrange an inspection and property-specific quote.

pages.summary: 了解哪些安全、清晰的照片可以帮助Ellis团队准备防水检查和书面维修报价。
pages.body_html:
MEL ONE 防水更新

堪培拉防水报价照片

了解哪些安全、清晰的照片可以帮助Ellis团队准备防水检查和书面维修报价。

我们会现场检查受影响区域，说明合适的维修工作，并确认书面报价。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

有助于防水报价沟通的照片

可拍摄受影响房间或外部区域的全景，再拍水渍、填缝开裂、密封胶失效、瓷砖翘起或墙地接缝的特写，并保留便于定位的参照。浴室可拍淋浴间、屏风、地面、相邻墙面，以及能安全接近的另一侧受潮房间；阳台可拍门槛、周边及可见楼下区域。

漏水照片的安全拍摄

使用稳定、光线充足的图像并避免使用滤镜。当症状明显时拍摄该区域，然后记下日期以及是否是在淋浴、下雨或其他事件之后发生的。请勿拆除瓷砖、切割密封剂、进入天花板空间或爬上屋顶以获得更好的视野。照片记录了一次观察；它不能确认隐蔽水路或替代现场评估。

防水维修详情附照片发送

pages.summary: We waterproof balconies and repair leaks at tiled surfaces, door thresholds, outlets and wall junctions. We inspect the balcony and any affected room below to define the repair.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Balcony Waterproofing & Leak Repairs in Canberra

We waterproof balconies and repair leaks at tiled surfaces, door thresholds, outlets and wall junctions. We inspect the balcony and any affected room below to define the repair.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Balcony ponding, drainage and membrane condition

Ponding describes water remaining on the surface; it does not establish where a leak starts. Drainage outlets, surface falls, thresholds and waterproofing junctions may need assessment together. Tell us where water collects, how long it remains after rain and whether staining appears below. A drainage issue and a waterproofing defect can require different work, even when both symptoms occur.

The balcony leak guide explains why a visible stain may not identify the entry point. If we need access to the waterproofing layer, our written scope separates tile removal, substrate work, membrane details and retiling from any separate drainage work.

Balcony leak records for strata managers

Share the dates and weather conditions, the affected locations above and below, any safely taken photographs and records of previous repairs. Identify who can arrange access to each area and ask what approval is required before an inspection or work begins. These records support the discussion; they do not establish responsibility for the defect or its cost. Contact MEL ONE about the balcony with the available information and any access or approval constraints so the proposed assessment can be discussed.

Balcony inspection and membrane repair paths

Accessible outlets, door thresholds, perimeter upturns, tile joints and the underside of the balcony are checked against the reported rain pattern. Ponding and staining help locate concerns but do not establish the complete concealed membrane condition.

An isolated junction may allow a local repair where the existing system can be reliably joined. Broader failure may require tile removal, substrate preparation, membrane renewal and retiling. Regrouting alone does not renew a balcony membrane; drainage alterations and structural repairs need their own scope.

Balcony repair scope

The written quote defines removal, membrane terminations, outlet and threshold details, finishes and any separate drainage tasks. Strata approval and access to the room below may be needed before work can be arranged.

  • Assessment of accessible tiled surfaces, door thresholds, drainage points and external junctions.
  • Preparation of the agreed balcony repair area before membrane or sealant work.
  • The Ellis team completes the listed waterproofing, retiling and finishing work; any separate drainage task is identified clearly.

Balcony repair access, removal and curing

  1. Describe rain-related symptoms, ponding and the rooms affected below the balcony.
  2. Arrange balcony and downstairs access, identify strata authority and confirm the repair or renewal boundary.
  3. Agree weather planning, curing, temporary access restrictions and reinstatement in the written quote.

Balcony regrouting and membrane replacement boundaries

MEL ONE offers standalone balcony regrouting, including epoxy grout where suitable. It can be an option for worn grout when the tiles and underlying construction are sound. Loose tiles, recurring leaks or moisture below need assessment before choosing a grout-only repair. Regrouting does not replace a failed waterproofing membrane.

Balcony regrouting and waterproofing cost factors

The area, old grout removal, material choice and access affect the quote. A grout-only repair is a different scope from tile removal, membrane renewal and retiling. Tell us whether you need grout repairs or have an active leak; our waterproofing quote checklist explains which inclusions to compare.

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Move furniture and plan an alternative route if the balcony is used for access. Report loose balustrades or unstable finishes before the visit.

pages.title: 堪培拉的阳台防水和漏水维修
pages.summary: 我们提供阳台防水与漏水维修，处理瓷砖表面、门槛、排水口和墙面接缝等部位，并结合阳台及楼下受影响房间检查，确定维修范围。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的阳台防水和漏水维修

我们提供阳台防水与漏水维修，处理瓷砖表面、门槛、排水口和墙面接缝等部位，并结合阳台及楼下受影响房间检查，确定维修范围。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

阳台积水、排水及膜状况

积水描述的是表面残留的水；它没有确定泄漏从哪里开始。排水口、地表落差、门槛和防水连接处可能需要一起评估。告诉我们水在哪里聚集、雨后停留多长时间以及下面是否出现污渍。排水问题和防水缺陷可能需要不同的工作，即使同时出现这两种症状。

的 阳台漏水指南 说明为什么不能仅凭可见水渍判断进水点。如需拆开饰面处理防水层，我们会在书面范围中分别列明拆砖、基层处理、防水层及重新铺砖，与单独的排水工作区分。

物业经理的阳台渗漏记录

请提供漏水日期、天气、上下层受影响位置、安全拍摄的照片及既往维修记录，并说明谁可安排各区域进场、检查或施工前需要哪些批准。这些记录有助于沟通，但不能据此确定缺陷或费用应由谁承担。 有关阳台的信息，请联系 MEL ONE 提供可用信息以及任何访问或批准限制，以便可以讨论拟议的评估。

阳台检查和膜修复路径

我们结合漏水与降雨的关系，检查可触及的排水口、门槛、周边防水上翻、瓷砖接缝和阳台底部。积水和水渍有助于定位问题，但不能完整说明隐蔽防水层的状况。

如问题局限于单一接缝，且能与原有完好系统可靠连接，可考虑局部维修。损坏较广时可能需要拆砖、基层准备、防水层更新及重新铺砖。仅重新填缝不能更新阳台防水层；排水改造和结构维修须另列范围。

阳台维修范围

书面报价定义了拆除、膜终端、出口和门槛细节、饰面和任何单独的排水任务。在安排工作之前，可能需要获得分层批准并进入下面的房间。

  • 评估可触及的瓷砖表面、门槛、排水点和外部连接处。
  • 在涂膜或密封剂工作之前，准备好约定的阳台维修区域。
  • Ellis团队完成所列的防水、重铺和饰面工作；任何单独的排水任务都被明确标识。

阳台维修的进场、拆除与固化安排

  1. 描述与下雨相关的症状、积水以及阳台下方受影响的房间。
  2. 安排阳台和楼下通道，识别分层权限并确认维修或更新边界。
  3. 在书面报价中同意天气计划、养护、临时现场进出限制和恢复。

阳台重新填缝和膜更换边界

我们提供单独的阳台重新填缝，包括在适合的情况下使用环氧填缝剂。瓷砖与底层构造完好、仅填缝磨损时，可考虑这类维修。若瓷砖松动、反复漏水或楼下受潮，应先检查原因；重新填缝不能替代失效的防水层。

阳台重新填缝和防水成本因素

面积、旧水泥基填缝剂清除、材料选择和通道都会影响报价。仅填缝修复的范围与瓷砖去除、膜更新和重新贴砖不同。告诉我们您是否需要填缝修复或存在主动泄漏；我们的 防水报价清单 解释要比较哪些内含物。

pages.title: Bathroom Waterproofing & Retiling in Canberra
pages.summary: We provide bathroom waterproofing and retiling for leaking showers and damaged wet areas. Your written quote sets out the removal, preparation, waterproofing and finishing work needed for your bathroom.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Bathroom Waterproofing & Retiling in Canberra

We provide bathroom waterproofing and retiling for leaking showers and damaged wet areas. Your written quote sets out the removal, preparation, waterproofing and finishing work needed for your bathroom.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Shower-only waterproofing and retiling

Sometimes a shower-only scope is feasible. The decision depends on the substrate, adjoining waterproofing details and how the repaired area can connect to the surrounding construction. Explain which fittings and finishes you want to retain so the assessment can establish the required access. A local scope still needs to address the affected waterproofing system.

Waterproofing and installation with customer-supplied tiles

If you have already bought tiles, send us their specifications, sizes and available quantity. We check suitability, layout, substrate condition and installation compatibility before including them in the work. Our written quote identifies who supplies tiles and other materials, with any additional preparation or tile requirements explained before you approve the scope.

Waterproofing work in a one-bathroom home

Tell MEL ONE before agreeing the scope. Ask which facilities will be unavailable and when access can resume, allowing for preparation, membrane and finishing requirements. The actual system and site conditions determine the sequence; arrange alternative washing facilities around the confirmed plan. Use the waterproofing and retiling quote guide to request separate removal, substrate, membrane, tiling, finishing and waste-removal items, then discuss your bathroom requirements.

Bathroom leak assessment and membrane renewal

Water staining, a leaking shower, loose tiles or failed silicone can be signs of a deeper wet-area issue. MEL ONE assesses the bathroom as a whole, including the shower base, wall-floor junctions, tiled finishes and nearby surfaces, before recommending the most suitable repair path for the property.

Where the waterproofing system needs renewal, the service can bring removal, substrate preparation, waterproofing membrane work, retiling and finishing work into one written scope. This gives you a clear view of what the bathroom repair includes before work starts.

Bathroom waterproofing scope

Your written scope is tailored to the bathroom and the condition found on site. Depending on the repair required, MEL ONE can include the following work as clearly listed items:

  • Removal of affected tiles, fittings or finishes where access to the waterproofing area is required.
  • Preparation and repair of the substrate before a new wet-area membrane system is applied.
  • Waterproofing membrane work to the agreed bathroom, shower or floor-and-wall junction areas.
  • Retiling, grout, silicone and agreed finishing work to return the bathroom to a practical finished condition.

Bathroom assessment, preparation and reinstatement

  1. Tell us what you are seeing. Call us with your suburb and the bathroom area affected or planned renovation. You can contact us without photographs or measurements.
  2. We define the repair scope. MEL ONE inspects and measures the wet area on site, checks the leak cause or renovation requirements and confirms waterproofing, access and finishing work in the work plan and written quote.
  3. We complete the agreed work. The repair is delivered to the written scope, with waterproofing and retiling work coordinated as required for the bathroom.

Bathroom waterproofing photographs

Bathroom waterproofing work photographs

These bathroom work images show preparation, membrane application and tiled finishes. The separate photographs in the project hub are not presented as a same-job before-and-after record. They illustrate visible work, while the cause, removal and reinstatement needed at your property require an on-site assessment.

View bathroom work photographs

Bathroom membrane and tiled-finish photographs →

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Book bathroom waterproofing

Arrange bathroom waterproofing and retiling in Belconnen, Gungahlin and Woden Valley. The Ellis team assesses the affected wet area and confirms preparation, membrane and finishing work in the written quote.

Request an on-site assessment and written quote for a repair or renovation. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them. Do not remove finishes to investigate damage. Tell us if this is the only bathroom so downtime and access can be planned.

Leaking Shower Repairs

For shower bases, screens, tiled joints and water escaping during normal shower use.

Shower Resealing & Regrouting

For failed silicone, cracked grout and worn shower junctions that need targeted repair.

Substrate checks before membrane installation

The exposed substrate needs to suit the selected system: its condition, moisture, junctions and previous coatings matter. Our preparation sequence is cleaning, repair and levelling before applying the specified waterproofing materials. Covering an unsound surface does not resolve the underlying problem.

Membrane curing, tiling and shower reuse

Tile-over time and return-to-use time are not the same. They depend on the product, coat thickness, temperature and drying conditions. Water-based flexible membranes such as ARDEX WPM 155 Rapid Plus and Gripset 38FC have their own application instructions. The agreed system determines the schedule; a fast-drying product description is not a same-day bathroom handover promise.

Bathroom waterproofing guides and project photos

Explore the repair options and relevant work photographs, then talk with us about your property.

部分情况可以只维修淋浴间，前提是基层、相邻防水细节及新旧构造能够可靠连接。请告诉我们希望保留哪些配件与饰面，方便现场确定拆检范围。即使是局部施工，也需要处理受影响的防水系统。

使用客户自备瓷砖的防水与铺贴安排

如果您已购买瓷砖，请提供产品规格、尺寸及现有数量。我们会检查瓷砖适用性、铺贴布局、基层状况及施工兼容性，再确认能否纳入本次工程。书面报价列明瓷砖和其他材料由谁提供；如需额外基层处理或补购瓷砖，会在您批准范围前说明。

家中只有一间浴室时的防水安排

若这是家中唯一的浴室，请在确认范围前告知我们，并沟通哪些设施会停用、何时恢复使用。基层准备、防水层及饰面施工都影响顺序和时间，请按确认的计划安排临时洗浴。可参考 防水和重铺报价指南 分别了解拆除、基层、防水层、铺砖、收尾及废料清运项目，再 讨论您的浴室要求.

浴室泄漏评估和膜更新

水渍、淋浴漏水、瓷砖松动或硅胶失效可能是更深层次湿区问题的迹象。 MEL ONE 对浴室进行整体评估，包括淋浴底座、墙地交界处、瓷砖饰面和附近表面，然后再推荐最适合该物业的维修路径。

防水系统需要更新时，我们可按约定将拆除、基层准备、防水层施工、重新铺砖及收尾纳入书面范围，让您在开工前了解本次浴室维修包含哪些项目。

卫浴防水范围

书面范围按浴室及现场状况制定。根据实际维修需要，我们可将以下工作作为明确列项纳入：

  • 拆除需要进入防水区域的受影响的瓷砖、配件或饰面。
  • 在应用新的湿区膜系统之前对基材进行准备和修复。
  • 在约定的浴室、淋浴间或地板与墙壁交界处铺设防水膜。
  • 重新铺瓷砖、填缝、硅胶和商定的整理工作，使浴室恢复到实际的完工状态。

浴室评估、准备和恢复

  1. 告诉我们您看到了什么。 请致电我们告知您所在的郊区以及受影响或计划进行翻修的浴室区域。您无需照片或尺寸即可联系我们。
  2. 我们定义维修范围。 MEL ONE 对现场湿区进行检查和测量，检查渗漏原因或改造要求，并在工作计划和书面报价中确认防水、通道和收尾工作。
  3. 我们完成约定的工作。 维修工作按照书面范围进行，并根据浴室的要求协调防水和重贴瓷砖工作。

卫生间防水照片

卫生间防水工作照片

这些浴室施工照片展示基层准备、防水层施工和铺砖完成的画面。案例页中的不同照片并非同一工程的前后对比。您物业的漏水原因、拆除与恢复范围，仍由现场评估确认。

查看浴室工作照片

浴室膜和瓷砖饰面照片 →

预约MEL ONE防水

预约卫生间防水

在 Belconnen、Gungahlin 和 Woden Valley 安排浴室防水和重铺瓷砖。Ellis团队评估受影响的湿区，并在书面报价中确认准备工作、膜和整理工作。

请求一个 现场评估并书面报价 用于维修或翻新。照片是可选的：将安全拍摄的照片通过电子邮件发送至 riley@melonemaintenance.com.au 或在没有照片的情况下联系我们。请勿拆除饰面来调查损坏情况。告诉我们这是否是唯一的浴室，以便可以计划停机时间和出入情况。

淋浴漏水维修

适用于淋浴底座、屏风、瓷砖接缝以及正常淋浴使用时漏水的情况。

淋浴间重新密封与填缝

对于失效的硅胶、开裂的水泥基填缝剂和磨损的淋浴接头，需要进行有针对性的修复。

防水层施工前的基层检查

露出的基层应适合所选防水系统，需考虑基层状况、含水情况、接缝和旧涂层。我们先清洁、修补、找平，再施工指定防水材料。覆盖不牢固的基层不能解决原有问题。

防水层固化、铺砖与淋浴恢复使用

可以铺砖的时间与可以恢复使用的时间并不相同，需结合产品、涂层厚度、温度和干燥条件确定。例如水性柔性防水材料 亚地斯 WPM 155 Rapid Plus 和 Gripset 38FC 有自己的应用说明。约定的系统确定时间表；快干产品说明并不是当天浴室交付的承诺。

浴室防水指南与施工照片

了解维修选择，查看相关施工记录，再与我们确认适合您房产的工作。

pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Commercial Waterproofing in Canberra

We provide commercial waterproofing for property owners, managers and strata representatives. We assess the affected area and set out the waterproofing work, site access and any separate trade tasks in the written scope.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

Waterproofing for commercial and strata properties

We provide commercial waterproofing for offices, shops, hospitality premises and apartment common areas across Canberra. Owners, property managers and strata representatives can request an assessment of a particular leak or an agreed waterproofing repair. The property type does not, on its own, determine the treatment.

Commercial waterproofing for the affected building area

A wet ceiling after rain, a leaking shared balcony and moisture near a bathroom can have different entry paths. Describe when the problem appears, which rooms or tenancies are affected and whether there have been previous repairs. We use that information and the site assessment to distinguish waterproofing work from plumbing, drainage or roof-covering repairs.

  • Bathroom waterproofing and retiling where the agreed work requires access beneath finishes.
  • Balcony waterproofing for tiled outdoor areas, thresholds and associated junctions.
  • Roof waterproofing around membrane areas and details such as penetrations and outlets.
  • External water ingress repairs and retaining wall waterproofing, with access and drainage considered separately.
  • Tile regrouting and local resealing where that limited scope matches the defect.

Planning commercial waterproofing in an occupied property

Tell us who can authorise the work, who controls access and whether the affected area is used by tenants, customers or staff. Include available inspection reports, drawings and previous repair information. Restricted access, shared areas and the time needed for materials to cure should be discussed before dates are agreed.

A strata balcony enquiry should identify the lot, shared access and the relevant property-manager contact. We do not assume that a resident can approve work to common property. If the work also needs a separately licensed trade, its responsibility should be stated in the quote.

Commercial waterproofing quote inclusions

Our commercial quote separates the affected areas, removal and preparation, waterproofing system, junction treatment and agreed finishes. Unrelated roofing, drainage, structural repairs and internal decoration are not included unless expressly listed.

Before accepting a quote, discuss access restrictions, disruption to the affected area, any requested work records and how changes to the scope will be approved. See the waterproofing quote checklist for questions to ask. No standard price or downtime is assumed before the site and work scope are known.

Commercial roof waterproofing

Roof waterproofing work and treatment at a raised roof junction.

Commercial waterproofing enquiries across Canberra

Tell us the property address and access arrangements when requesting a quote. Site conditions determine the repair scope and suitable materials.

Call 0482 422 607 or use the waterproofing service form. Include the suburb, affected area and when the problem appears. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them. Do not enter an unsafe area to take photos.

We complete an on-site assessment and confirm the agreed work and written quote before starting.

pages.summary: 我们为商业物业业主、物业经理和分层物业代表提供防水服务，现场评估后，在书面范围中列明防水工作、进场安排及需单独处理的其他工种任务。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的商业防水

我们为商业物业业主、物业经理和分层物业代表提供防水服务，现场评估后，在书面范围中列明防水工作、进场安排及需单独处理的其他工种任务。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

商业及分层产权物业防水

我们为堪培拉的办公室、商铺、餐饮住宿场所及公寓公共区域提供商业防水服务。业主、物业经理及分层物业代表可就具体漏水或防水维修申请现场评估。我们根据实际进水部位确定方法，而不是仅按物业类型套用方案。

受影响建筑区域的商业防水

雨后潮湿的天花板、漏水的共用阳台以及浴室附近的湿气可能有不同的进入路径。描述问题何时出现、哪些房间或租户受到影响以及之前是否进行过维修。我们利用这些信息和现场评估来区分防水工作与管道、排水或屋顶覆盖维修。

  • 卫生间防水及重铺瓷砖 商定的工作需要进入饰面下方。
  • 阳台防水 适用于铺有瓷砖的室外区域、门槛和相关路口。
  • 屋顶防水 处理防水层区域、穿出部位及排水口等细节。
  • 外部进水维修 和 挡土墙防水，并分别确认进场与排水要求。
  • 瓷砖重新填缝 以及在有限范围与缺陷相匹配的情况下进行局部重新密封。

规划已占用物业的商业防水

告诉我们谁可以授权这项工作、谁控制访问以及受影响的区域是否由租户、客户或员工使用。包括可用的检查报告、图纸和以前的维修信息。在商定日期之前，应讨论限制进入、共享区域和材料固化所需的时间。

分层产权物业的阳台咨询，应说明具体单元、共用通道及相关物业经理。住户不一定有权批准公共区域施工；如还需单独持牌工种，报价应列明其责任。

pages.summary: We repair water entry around windows, doors and wall junctions. Our assessment considers rain exposure, adjoining ground levels and drainage so the repair addresses the affected detail.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

External Waterproofing & Water Ingress Repairs in Canberra

We repair water entry around windows, doors and wall junctions. Our assessment considers rain exposure, adjoining ground levels and drainage so the repair addresses the affected detail.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Window leaks in wind-driven rain

The window joints, frame drainage and surrounding wall details may all be relevant. Tell us which side gets wet first and whether the problem occurs only with a particular wind direction. Water visible beside the frame can originate elsewhere, so the symptom alone does not justify sealing every opening or coating the wall. Dampness that also appears without rain may need a different investigation.

Back-door sealing and external waterproofing boundaries

We check the door threshold, adjoining joints, outside surface levels and drainage before recommending sealing work. Describe whether water reaches the doorway as surface runoff or appears through a particular gap. A local seal is useful only where it addresses an identified joint defect; threshold or drainage work may need a separate scope.

Wall-side ponding, drainage and waterproofing assessment

Ask for drainage and surface falls to be considered alongside any water-entry detail. A coating alone may leave the source of pooled water unresolved. The waterproofing or drainage guide helps frame the discussion. For water appearing at the eaves, start with the roof leak service. Otherwise, report the rain pattern and affected area so the appropriate assessment can be discussed.

External water ingress inspection locations

We consider the window perimeter, door threshold, wall-base junctions and accessible external joints alongside internal staining. Wind-driven rain, water pooling against a wall and persistent moisture when the weather is dry can indicate different causes.

Local joint sealing may suit an accessible isolated gap. Failed wall details or concealed interfaces may need opening and reinstatement; coating an internal stain does not establish or stop the source. Drainage changes, structural faults and window replacement are separate tasks where required.

External waterproofing repair scope

The written quote identifies the external detail being repaired, preparation, compatible sealing or membrane work and finish reinstatement. It also records access equipment and any separately licensed drainage or building work.

  • Assessment of accessible wall, window, threshold and external junction details.
  • Preparation and repair planning for the defined water-entry path.
  • The Ellis team completes the agreed sealing and waterproofing work; any separate drainage or licensed roofing task is listed clearly in the quote.

External leak repair access and work sequence

  1. Record the rain direction, wall or opening affected and any ground-level ponding.
  2. Arrange safe access to both sides of the affected window, door or wall where possible.
  3. Agree the water-entry repair and any coordinated drainage work before covering affected finishes.

For moisture beside retained soil or an adjoining garage, see our retaining wall waterproofing service.

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Request external leak assessment

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Advise about narrow side passages, neighbouring property access and high windows. Keep clear of wet electrical fittings; do not climb to inspect upper-storey joints.

Balcony Waterproofing & Leak Repairs

Explore the related MEL ONE waterproofing service.

Leaking Shower Repairs

Explore the related MEL ONE waterproofing service.

Rainwater ingress and condensation assessment

Moisture that follows wind-driven rain may involve an external junction, window detail or drainage path. Condensation can relate to humidity and cold surfaces. Timing helps the investigation but does not prove the cause. Note the weather, room and visible pattern before choosing an exterior coating.

Water pooling beside the house may need drainage work rather than another sealant layer. The waterproofing or drainage guide explains that distinction; commercial waterproofing enquiries follow the same assessment-first approach.

Rainwater ingress guides and waterproofing project photos

Explore the repair options and relevant work photographs, then talk with us about your property.

pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的外部防水和进水维修

我们维修窗户、门口和墙面接缝周围的进水问题，现场结合迎雨方向、相邻地面高差和排水情况检查，确定需要处理的部位。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

风雨中窗户漏水

窗户接缝、框架排水和周围墙壁的细节都可能相关。告诉我们哪一侧首先被弄湿以及问题是否仅在特定风向发生。框架旁边可见的水可能来自其他地方，因此仅凭症状并不能证明密封每个开口或涂上墙壁是合理的。没有下雨也出现的潮湿可能需要不同的调查。

后门密封及外部防水边界

我们先检查门槛、相邻接缝、室外地面高差和排水情况，再确定是否采用接缝密封维修。请说明水是从地面流到门口，还是从某个缝隙进入。局部密封用于已确认的接缝缺陷；门槛或排水工作可能需要单独列项。

墙边积水、排水、防水评估

要求将排水和地表落差与任何进水细节一起考虑。单独的涂层可能无法解决积水的来源。的 防水或排水指南 有助于构建讨论。对于出现在屋檐处的水，从 屋顶漏水服务。否则， 报告降雨模式和受影响区域 因此可以讨论适当的评估。

外部进水检查位置

我们考虑窗户周边、门槛、墙基连接处和可触及的外部接缝以及内部染色。风雨、墙壁积水以及天气干燥时持续潮湿可能表明不同的原因。

局部接缝密封可能适用于可接触的单一缝隙。墙体细节失效或隐蔽连接问题可能需要拆开及恢复；涂盖室内水渍不能查明或阻止进水。如需排水改造、结构维修或换窗，应分别安排。

外墙防水维修范围

书面报价列明需维修的外部部位、准备工作、兼容的密封或防水层施工及饰面恢复，并说明进场设备及需单独持牌人员负责的排水或建筑工作。

  • 评估可进入的墙壁、窗户、门槛和外部连接处细节。
  • 确定的进水路径的准备和修复计划。
  • Ellis团队完成约定的密封防水工作；报价中明确列出了任何单独的排水或许可的屋顶任务。

外部渗漏维修的进场与施工顺序

  1. 记录降雨方向、受影响的墙壁或开口以及任何地面积水。
  2. 尽可能安排安全通道进入受影响的窗户、门或墙壁的两侧。
  3. 在覆盖受影响的饰面之前，同意进水修复和任何协调的排水工作。

如挡土区域或相邻车库旁出现潮湿，请查看我们的 挡土墙防水服务.

就狭窄的侧通道、邻近的物业通道和高窗户提供建议。远离潮湿的电气装置；请勿攀爬检查上层接缝。

雨水进入和冷凝评估

风雨后的湿气可能会涉及外部连接处、窗户细节或排水路径。冷凝可能与湿度和寒冷的表面有关。时间安排有助于调查，但不能证明原因。在选择外墙涂料之前，请注意天气、房间和可见图案。

房屋旁边的积水可能需要排水工作，而不是另一个密封层。的 防水或排水指南 解释这种区别； 商业防水查询 遵循相同的评估优先方法。

pages.summary: We reseal split or detached joints around kitchen sinks, benchtops and splashbacks. We check whether water is passing through a surface joint or leaking from plumbing below before confirming the sealing work.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Kitchen Sealing & Resealing in Canberra

We reseal split or detached joints around kitchen sinks, benchtops and splashbacks. We check whether water is passing through a surface joint or leaking from plumbing below before confirming the sealing work.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Under-sink leaks, kitchen sealing and plumbing repairs

A wet cupboard can result from a sink-edge joint or plumbing below the sink. We check the water path before recommending resealing. Water appearing after splashes on the benchtop may point towards a sink-edge joint. Water appearing around a tap connection, trap or waste pipe needs plumbing assessment. Describe when the cupboard gets wet and where you first notice water without dismantling connections to investigate.

If an accessible sink perimeter or splashback-to-benchtop joint is the confirmed issue, the sealing scope can identify the old sealant to remove, the surfaces to prepare and the joints to reseal. The sink resealing or plumbing guide helps explain which details to report.

Sink resealing and water-damaged cabinet restoration

Resealing a confirmed joint leak addresses that water path; it does not restore a swollen or softened cabinet board. Find and address the moisture source before planning replacement or other cabinet repairs. Ask whether damage around the joint affects the sealing work, and have any cabinet restoration identified separately. Describe the sink, cupboard and timing to discuss the appropriate assessment. A kitchen sealing quote should specify its actual junction repairs rather than assume the same scope as a bathroom renovation.

Kitchen sink and splashback sealing assessment

The sink rim, benchtop junctions and splashback edges are checked for gaps, detachment and moisture. Accessible cabinet interiors help show whether water follows use of the sink or appears from a supply, waste or appliance connection.

Resealing can address a suitable perimeter joint after old sealant is removed and the surfaces are prepared. It does not repair leaking pipes, failed tap connections, swollen cabinet panels or a loose sink support; those tasks are identified separately.

Kitchen joint sealing scope

The sealing scope names the sink rim or splashback joints to be treated and the compatible replacement sealant. Cabinet restoration and plumbing repairs are excluded unless separately arranged in the written quote.

  • Assessment of accessible sink edges, splashbacks, benchtop joints and cabinet moisture signs.
  • Removal of deteriorated sealant from the defined kitchen junctions.
  • Resealing and finishing by the Ellis team; a leaking pipe or tap is identified separately as plumbing work.

Kitchen joint preparation and sink access

  1. Describe where the cabinet first becomes wet and whether moisture occurs while the sink is unused.
  2. Clear the cupboard for an on-site assessment of accessible sink edges and moisture paths.
  3. Agree the joint repair, drying and curing period; a plumber handles identified supply or waste faults.

pages.summary: 我们更换厨房水槽、台面和防溅板周围开裂或脱落的密封胶。施工前先区分表面接缝渗水与下方管道漏水，再确认密封维修范围。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的厨房密封和重新密封

我们更换厨房水槽、台面和防溅板周围开裂或脱落的密封胶。施工前先区分表面接缝渗水与下方管道漏水，再确认密封维修范围。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

水槽下漏水、厨房密封和管道维修

橱柜潮湿可能来自水槽边缘接缝，也可能来自水槽下方管道。我们先检查水的路径，再确定是否需要重新密封。台面溅水后出现潮湿，可能与水槽边缘有关；水龙头连接、存水弯或排水管周围出现水，则需要检查水管。请说明受潮时间及最先发现水的位置，不要自行拆开连接件检查。

如果确认问题是可触及的水槽周边或防溅板与台面的接缝，密封范围可以识别要去除的旧密封剂、要准备的表面以及要重新密封的接缝。的 水槽重新密封或管道指南 帮助解释要报告哪些详细信息。

水槽重新密封和水损坏的橱柜修复

重新密封已确认的接头泄漏可解决该水路问题；它不能修复肿胀或软化的橱柜板。在计划更换或其他机柜维修之前，找到并解决湿气源。询问接缝周围的损坏是否影响密封工作，并单独确定是否有橱柜修复。 描述水槽、橱柜和时间 讨论适当的评估。厨房密封报价应具体说明其实际的连接处维修，而不是假定与浴室翻新的范围相同。

厨房水槽和防溅板密封评估

检查水槽边缘、台面接缝及防溅板边缘的缝隙、脱胶和受潮情况。可接触的柜内区域有助于判断水是在水槽使用后出现，还是来自供水、排水或家电连接。

在清除旧胶并准备好粘接表面后，重新密封可处理适用的周边接缝。漏水管道、水龙头连接故障、受潮膨胀柜板或松动的水槽支撑，则需分别处理。

厨房接缝密封范围

密封范围列明需处理的水槽边缘或防溅板接缝，以及兼容的新密封胶。橱柜恢复与水管维修只有在书面报价中另行安排时才包含。

  • 评估可触及的水槽边缘、防溅板、台面接缝和橱柜潮湿迹象。
  • 清除指定厨房接缝处变质的密封剂。
  • 由Ellis团队重新密封和整理；漏水的管道或水龙头被单独识别为管道工程。

厨房接缝处理与水槽周边施工条件

  1. 描述柜子首先变湿的位置以及水槽未使用时是否发生潮湿。
  2. 请清空橱柜，便于现场检查可接触的水槽边缘及进水路径。
  3. 约定接缝修补、干燥、养护期限；水管工处理已识别的供应或排水故障。

申请厨房密封服务

请求一个 现场评估并书面报价，或致电 0482 422 607。照片是可选的：将安全拍摄的照片通过电子邮件发送至 riley@melonemaintenance.com.au 或在没有照片的情况下联系我们。

请清空受影响橱柜，并移开水槽旁台面上的物品。如有连接水管的洗碗机或其他家电，请提前说明；不要为了拍照自行断开管道。

pages.summary: We waterproof laundry floors and wet-area junctions for renovations and repairs. We check the substrate and planned finishes before setting out the preparation and installation work.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Laundry Waterproofing in Canberra

We waterproof laundry floors and wet-area junctions for renovations and repairs. We check the substrate and planned finishes before setting out the preparation and installation work.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Laundry waterproofing preparation before tiling

Arrange assessment before new tiles cover the floor and junctions. Tell MEL ONE whether old tiles remain, what preparation is already complete and who is handling tiling and appliance connections. Share the proposed tile finish and any changes to the floor waste or doorway so the waterproofing scope can be reviewed against the planned layout.

Agree who prepares the substrate, who confirms it is ready for the next stage and how the selected membrane's curing requirements affect the tiling sequence. Confirm appliance disconnection and reconnection separately with the responsible trade. Use the quote guide to prepare questions, then discuss the laundry before booking the next stage.

Laundry floor and wet-area inspection

The floor waste, wall-to-floor junctions, tub area and accessible washing-machine connections are considered with the existing substrate. Moisture after washing may come from an appliance hose or waste connection rather than the floor membrane.

Membrane renewal may involve removing tiles, repairing the substrate and reinstating finishes. Local silicone repairs suit only the specified junctions. Appliance servicing, supply and waste plumbing, electrical work and structural floor repairs need separate arrangements when required.

Laundry floor moisture and plumbing leak assessment

Water near a washing machine can come from a hose, valve, waste connection, overflow or a wet-area junction. The timing of the water and its starting point matter. A confirmed pipe or waste fault is plumbing work. The Ellis team completes the agreed waterproofing work directly, with any licensed plumbing task listed separately in the written quote.

Laundry waterproofing and tiling scope

For a laundry renovation, we set out the floor and wall areas, substrate preparation, drain and threshold details, waterproofing and agreed finishes in the written scope. Appliance moving, reconnection and any separate plumbing work are identified so you can plan the laundry downtime.

Laundry membrane repair scope

The laundry quote records preparation, waterproofing extent, penetrations, waste details and tiling or finishing work. Confirm whether appliance moving and reconnection are included, and which appropriately licensed trade performs regulated work.

  • Review of the laundry floor, wall junctions, floor waste and appliance connections to distinguish water entry paths.
  • Preparation of the specified wet-area substrate and membrane details as part of an agreed renovation or repair.
  • The Ellis team completes the listed waterproofing, tiling and finishing; licensed plumbing connections are listed separately.

Laundry waterproofing preparation and return to use

  1. Describe moisture timing, renovation plans and the position of the tub, washing machine and floor waste.
  2. Arrange an on-site assessment and confirm any appliance removal needed to inspect concealed edges.
  3. Agree the installation requirements, written quote, curing periods and temporary laundry arrangements.

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Book laundry waterproofing

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Plan temporary washing facilities and clear stored items. Do not move heavy appliances or disconnect water or electrical connections yourself for the assessment.

Bathroom Waterproofing & Retiling

Explore the related MEL ONE waterproofing service.

Waterproofing & Retiling Quote Guide

Read the related MEL ONE guide for property owners.

Laundry substrate and membrane checks before tiling

Confirm the floor condition, drainage arrangement, wall-to-floor junctions and penetrations before finishes cover them. Existing coatings and moisture can affect preparation and material selection. A leaking washing-machine connection or waste pipe needs a separate plumbing diagnosis; a new floor membrane is not a pipe repair.

Discuss any proposed flooring change during the assessment so the substrate, membrane and tile finish can be considered together. See kitchen and laundry questions for the difference between a surface seal and a wet-area waterproofing scope.

pages.summary: 我们为洗衣房翻新与维修提供地面和湿区接缝防水，先检查基层及计划使用的饰面，再明确基层处理和防水施工内容。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的洗衣房防水

我们为洗衣房翻新与维修提供地面和湿区接缝防水，先检查基层及计划使用的饰面，再明确基层处理和防水施工内容。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

洗衣房贴砖前防水准备工作

新砖覆盖地面与接缝前，请先安排评估，并告诉我们旧砖是否保留、已做哪些准备，以及谁负责铺砖和家电连接。计划中的瓷砖、地漏或门口改动也请说明，以便结合布局确认防水范围。

就谁准备基材、谁确认基材已准备好进入下一阶段以及所选膜的固化要求如何影响瓷砖顺序达成一致。与负责的行业单独确认设备的断开和重新连接。使用 报价指南 准备问题，然后 在预约下一阶段之前讨论洗衣事宜.

洗衣房地板和湿区检查

我们结合现有基层，检查地漏、墙地接缝、洗衣槽区域及可触及的洗衣机连接。洗衣后出现水分，可能来自家电软管或排水连接，不一定是地面防水层。

更新防水层可能涉及拆砖、修复基层和恢复饰面；局部密封胶维修仅处理指定接缝。如需家电检修、给排水管、电气或地面结构维修，应另行安排。

洗衣房地板湿度和管道泄漏评估

洗衣房防水及瓷砖范围

洗衣膜修复范围

洗衣房报价列明准备工作、防水区域、穿管和地漏细节，以及铺砖或收尾内容，并说明家电搬移、重新连接是否包含及需持牌人员负责的工作。

  • 检查洗衣房地面、墙面接缝、地漏和家电连接，区分进水路径。
  • 作为商定的翻新或维修的一部分，准备指定的湿区基材和膜细节。
  • Ellis团队完成列出的防水、瓷砖和饰面；获得许可的管道连接单独列出。

洗衣房防水准备与恢复使用安排

  1. 请说明潮湿出现的时间、翻新计划，以及洗衣槽、洗衣机和地漏的位置。
  2. 安排现场评估并确认检查隐藏边缘所需的任何设备移除。
  3. 同意安装要求、书面报价、养护期和临时洗衣安排。

pages.title: Leaking Shower Repairs in Canberra
pages.summary: We assess and repair leaking showers when water reaches the carpet, adjoining walls or areas outside the shower. We check the source on site before confirming the repair.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Leaking Shower Repairs in Canberra

We assess and repair leaking showers when water reaches the carpet, adjoining walls or areas outside the shower. We check the source on site before confirming the repair.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Carpet, paint and ceiling moisture after shower use

Wet carpet beside the shower, bubbling paint on the wall behind it or a ceiling drip after an upstairs shower are reasons to arrange an assessment. These signs alone do not identify a failed membrane. Water may escape through a screen edge or junction, or come from a supply or waste connection. A plumbing fault needs a plumber; a waterproofing repair should follow the assessed water path.

Tell us where the first moisture appears, whether it follows every shower and whether it also occurs when the shower is unused. Existing photos and a description of earlier repairs can help. Our shower plumbing or waterproofing guide explains the different repair paths.

Recurring shower leaks after regrouting or resealing

A surface repair may not have addressed the source, or another detail may need attention. Before paying for more grout or silicone, describe what was repaired and whether the symptom changed. The assessment can then consider those details and whether access beneath finishes is needed. Bathroom waterproofing and retiling is the route for an agreed membrane renewal scope; contact MEL ONE if the cause is still unclear.

Shower leak inspection and repair options

The inspection considers the shower base, screen edges, wall-to-floor junctions, floor waste and finishes in the adjacent room. When moisture appears after use, we consider surface escape as well as concealed paths; a stain alone cannot identify a failed membrane.

A local screen-edge or joint repair may suit an isolated defect. Recurring leaks, loose tiles or damage beneath finishes may need access for membrane renewal and retiling. Supply or waste pipe faults require a plumber and are identified separately in the written quote.

Shower repair scope

The shower repair scope identifies the affected detail, any tile removal and the extent of reinstatement. Keep the shower available for inspection and tell us if it is the only shower in use.

  • Assessment of the shower base, screen edges, tiled joints and nearby finishes.
  • Removal and preparation work where access is needed to the affected waterproofing detail.
  • Agreed waterproofing, tiling, grout, silicone and finishing work for the defined repair path.

Shower leak assessment, repair and bathroom access

  1. Record whether moisture follows shower use, appears while unused or reaches the adjacent room.
  2. Arrange an on-site assessment of the shower and adjoining finishes; agree any further access before removal.
  3. Confirm the written quote, repair boundaries and shower downtime, including curing and return-to-use instructions.

Bathroom membrane and tiled-finish photographs →

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Request shower leak assessment

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Clear personal items from the shower and the affected adjoining area. Do not lift tiles or remove a screen to investigate the leak.

pages.summary: 淋浴间漏水导致地毯、相邻墙面或淋浴区外受潮时，我们提供现场检查与维修，先查明进水原因，再确认处理方案。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉淋浴漏水维修

淋浴间漏水导致地毯、相邻墙面或淋浴区外受潮时，我们提供现场检查与维修，先查明进水原因，再确认处理方案。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

淋浴后地毯、油漆和天花板受潮

淋浴间旁地毯潮湿、背墙油漆起泡，或使用楼上淋浴后天花板滴水，都需要安排检查；这些迹象本身不能证明防水层失效。水可能从屏风边缘或接缝流出，也可能来自供水或排水连接。管道故障需由水管工处理，防水维修则按检查确认的进水路径确定。

告诉我们第一次出现湿气的位置，是否每次淋浴后都会出现湿气，以及是否在未使用淋浴时也会出现湿气。现有的照片和早期维修的描述会有所帮助。我们的 淋浴管道或防水指南 解释不同的修复路径。

重新填缝或重新密封后淋浴间反复漏水

表面修复可能没有解决源头问题，或者可能需要注意其他细节。在支付更多的水泥基填缝剂或硅胶之前，请描述修复的内容以及症状是否发生变化。然后评估可以考虑这些细节以及是否需要进入饰面下方。 卫生间防水及重铺瓷砖 是商定的膜更新范围的路线； 联系 MEL ONE 如果原因还不清楚。

淋浴漏水检查和维修选项

我们检查淋浴底部、屏风边缘、墙地接缝、地漏和相邻房间饰面。使用后出现潮湿时，会同时考虑表面水外流与隐蔽进水路径，不能仅凭水渍认定防水层失效。

局部淋浴屏风边缘或接缝维修，可能适合单一且明确的缺陷。反复漏水、瓷砖松动或饰面下受损，可能需要拆检、更换防水层并重新铺砖。供水或排水管故障由水管工处理，并在书面报价中单列。

淋浴间漏水维修范围

淋浴间维修范围确定了受影响的细节、任何瓷砖去除以及恢复的程度。保持淋浴可供检查，并告诉我们它是否是唯一正在使用的淋浴。

  • 评估淋浴底座、屏风边缘、瓷砖接缝和附近饰面。
  • 需要接触受影响的防水细节的拆除和准备工作。
  • 就指定的修复路径商定防水、瓷砖、填缝、硅胶和饰面工作。

淋浴漏水检查、维修与浴室使用安排

  1. 记录湿气是否在使用淋浴后、未使用时出现或到达相邻房间。
  2. 安排现场检查淋浴间及相邻饰面；如需拆检，先确认范围再拆除。
  3. 确认书面报价、维修范围和淋浴停机时间，包括固化和恢复使用说明。

pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Retaining Wall Waterproofing in Canberra

We provide retaining-wall waterproofing for damp wall faces and water entering adjoining areas. We check access to the soil-facing side and the drainage conditions before confirming the repair method.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Retaining wall moisture and access assessment

We consider wall joints, visible cracks, the adjoining garage or room and accessible drainage outlets. Soil-side waterproofing and backfill drainage cannot be confirmed from the exposed face alone; water after rain may involve both the wall barrier and drainage.

Soil-side membrane repair may require excavation and reinstatement. An internal treatment has limits and does not remove water pressure behind the wall. Wall movement, structural damage, excavation support and drainage installation need appropriate specialist assessment and separate scope.

Garage water entry beside a retaining wall after rain

Water at a garage wall can follow soil moisture, surface runoff, drainage defects or a wall junction. The visible damp patch alone cannot establish the source or whether pressure is acting behind the wall. The Ellis team reviews the rain pattern and accessible wall and drainage details during an on-site assessment, then confirms the repair plan and written quote.

Retaining wall access and internal treatment limitations

The repair side and method depend on how the wall was built and whether the soil-facing surface can be reached. An internal coating is not automatically equivalent to addressing water on the retained side. Where excavation, drainage design or structural movement is involved, the relevant specialist input should be included in the agreed scope.

Retaining wall repair scope

Our retaining-wall quote identifies the wall face we can access, preparation, waterproofing terminations and the reinstatement boundary. Excavation, drainage and structural tasks are listed separately from membrane work.

  • Inspection of accessible wall faces, adjoining ground levels, drainage outlets and the timing of moisture after rainfall.
  • The Ellis team checks access, excavation and drainage conditions before defining the waterproofing scope; any specialist structural task is listed separately.
  • Preparation, waterproofing and protection work only for the retaining-wall area confirmed in the written scope.

Retaining wall access and waterproofing sequence

  1. Describe rain-related seepage, adjoining rooms and visible wall changes without disturbing the backfill.
  2. Arrange an on-site assessment of accessible faces and discuss soil-side access, buried services and excavation constraints.
  3. Agree the written quote and any structural, drainage or excavation responsibilities before work starts.

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Book retaining wall waterproofing

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Tell us about narrow access, fences, landscaping and nearby structures. Do not excavate behind a retaining wall or approach a moving or unstable wall to investigate moisture.

pages.summary: 我们为挡土墙墙面潮湿及邻接区域进水提供防水服务，先检查土侧是否可进场施工及排水条件，再确认处理方法。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉挡土墙防水

我们为挡土墙墙面潮湿及邻接区域进水提供防水服务，先检查土侧是否可进场施工及排水条件，再确认处理方法。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

挡土墙湿度和通道评估

我们考虑墙壁接缝、可见的裂缝、毗邻的车库或房间以及无障碍的排水口。仅从暴露面无法确认土侧防水和回填排水；雨后积水可能涉及墙体屏障和排水系统。

土侧膜修复可能需要挖掘和恢复。内部处理有其局限性，并且不能消除墙后的水压。墙体移动、结构损坏、开挖支护和排水安装需要适当的专家评估和单独的范围。

雨后挡土墙旁的车库进水口

车库墙壁上的水可能会随着土壤湿度、地表径流、排水缺陷或墙壁连接处而出现。仅凭可见的潮湿斑块无法确定来源或压力是否作用在墙后。Ellis团队在现场评估期间审查降雨模式以及可进入的墙壁和排水细节，然后确认修复计划和书面报价。

挡土墙通道和内部处理限制

施工面和方法取决于墙体构造及能否接近土侧墙面。内侧涂层不等于从土侧处理进水；如涉及开挖、排水设计或结构位移，应将相关专业人员的评估纳入约定范围。

挡土墙修复范围

我们的挡土墙报价列明可进场施工的墙面、基层处理、防水层收口及恢复范围；开挖、排水和结构任务与防水层工作分别列示。

  • 检查可接触的墙面、相邻地面高差、排水口，以及降雨后出现潮湿的时间。
  • Ellis团队在确定防水范围之前检查通道、挖掘和排水条件；任何专门的结构任务都单独列出。
  • 仅对书面范围内确认的挡土墙区域进行准备、防水和防护工作。

挡土墙防水的施工条件与顺序

  1. 描述与雨水相关的渗漏、相邻房间和可见的墙壁变化，而不影响回填。
  2. 安排对可进入面的现场评估，并讨论土壤侧通道、埋地服务和挖掘限制。
  3. 在开始工作之前，同意书面报价以及任何结构、排水或挖掘责任。

预约MEL ONE防水

申请挡土墙防水服务

请求一个 现场评估并书面报价，或致电 0482 422 607。照片是可选的：将安全拍摄的照片通过电子邮件发送至 riley@melonemaintenance.com.au 或在没有照片的情况下联系我们。

请告诉我们通道宽度、围栏、景观及附近构造情况。不要为了查潮湿在挡土墙后开挖，也不要接近已位移或不稳定的墙体。

pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Roof Leaks & Waterproofing in Canberra

We assess roof leaks and carry out waterproofing at membrane surfaces, penetrations and outlets. We plan the inspection around the roof construction and safe access, then explain the repair scope.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Eaves leak records for roof repair assessment

Describe where it appears, whether gutters visibly overflow and whether a ceiling or wall inside is also affected. Eaves dripping during rain can involve roof or gutter details; the observation does not identify a membrane defect. Report what you can see from a safe position on the ground and let the assessment determine any access needed.

Roof-to-wall junction leak assessment details

Tell us the affected room, the weather when the leak starts and any previous flashing or roof repairs. Existing plans or photographs help us understand the roof construction. We identify the affected junction and any separate roofing or drainage task in the proposed scope before agreeing the treatment. Discuss the roof leak with MEL ONE; if water instead appears around a window or doorway, see external water ingress repairs.

Roof leak inspection and treatment boundaries

The inspection considers accessible membrane seams, flashing interfaces, penetration bases and outlets against the room and weather reported. Water can travel from a roof-to-wall junction before it appears inside, so the internal stain is only one clue.

A local membrane or junction repair needs a compatible, sound surrounding system. Wider deterioration may require membrane renewal. Roof painting does not repair a failed flashing or penetration; roof-covering replacement, gutter alterations and separately licensed roofing or drainage work are listed apart from waterproofing.

Roof leaks during heavy rain

Wind-driven rain, overflowing gutters, blocked outlets and a vulnerable flashing or wall junction can each change where water enters. A stain inside the building does not always sit directly below the entry point. Record the weather, affected room and any safe exterior photographs before arranging a roof leak assessment.

Roof painting and waterproofing system differences

A coating described as roof paint is not automatically a repair for a failed flashing, penetration or waterproofing membrane. The existing roof assembly and the confirmed water path determine the work scope. If a roof-covering repair needs a licensed roofer, the quote lists that task separately from the Ellis team’s waterproofing work.

Roof waterproofing scope

The written quote identifies safe access equipment, the membrane or junction being treated, substrate preparation and any separate roof or drainage tasks. Weather exposure and the condition of the roof may affect when work can proceed.

  • Review of the reported leak timing, roof surface, penetrations, flashings and adjacent wall junctions where safely accessible.
  • Identification of whether the agreed path is a local roof repair, a membrane detail or related drainage work.
  • A clear written scope for the Ellis team’s waterproofing work and any separately licensed roof or drainage task before work begins.

Roof waterproofing access, preparation and weather

  1. Describe the affected room, rain conditions and any ground-level observation of overflowing gutters or outlets.
  2. Let the team arrange safe access and an on-site assessment of the relevant roof details.
  3. Agree the written quote, weather window, membrane repair boundaries and any coordinated roofing work.

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Request roof leak assessment

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Stay on the ground when recording roof symptoms. Keep away from sagging ceilings and water near electrical fittings; active water and electrical hazards need prompt appropriate assistance.

In April 2026, the Ellis team completed roof waterproofing work at a property in Isaacs, Woden Valley. The work covered roof details around the chimney, ventilation outlets and eaves drainage outlets. These details were part of the project scope, rather than roof painting alone.

Waterproofing substrate preparation

Our substrate repair sequence is cleaning, repair, levelling and application of the selected waterproofing materials. Depending on the agreed system, roof work can involve laying a waterproofing membrane, applying a barrier coating and treating joints with a suitable waterproofing sealant. Materials are selected for the site; these stages are not a tile-regrouting specification.

Roof membranes and moisture barriers have different roles. A sheet membrane needs suitable seams and terminations; an exposed system must be specified for its conditions. As manufacturer examples, ARDEX WPM 185 is a cap sheet for exposed membrane systems, while ARDEX WPM 300 is an epoxy primer/barrier coating. These examples explain the distinction, not the products used on the Isaacs project.
