pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉屋顶漏水和防水

我们提供屋顶漏水评估，处理防水层、穿出屋面的管件周边及排水口等部位。现场按屋面结构与安全进场条件安排检查，再说明维修范围。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

屋檐漏水记录用于屋顶修复评估

请说明滴水位置、天沟是否明显溢水，以及室内天花板或墙面是否受影响。雨天屋檐滴水可能涉及屋面或天沟问题，仅凭这一现象不能确定防水层有无缺陷。请从地面安全位置描述可见情况，由现场评估确定检查与进场安排。

屋面与墙面交界处的漏水检查

请告诉我们受影响的房间、开始漏水时的天气，以及以往泛水板或屋顶维修情况。现有图纸或照片有助于我们了解屋面构造。确认处理方法前，我们会在拟定范围中列明问题接缝，以及需单独处理的屋面或排水任务。 与 MEL ONE 讨论屋顶漏水问题;如果窗户或门口周围出现水，请参阅 外部进水维修.

屋顶渗漏检查和处理边界

检查时，会结合漏水房间和天气记录，查看能够安全接触的防水层接缝、泛水连接、穿出部位底座及排水口。水可能先从屋面与墙面交界处流动，再出现在室内，因此室内水渍只是线索之一。

局部防水层或接缝维修，需要能与周边完好系统可靠连接；损坏较广时可能需要更新防水层。屋顶涂漆不能修复失效泛水板或穿出部位。屋面覆盖物更换、天沟改造及需持牌人员负责的屋面或排水工作，与防水分别列项。

大雨时屋顶漏水

风雨、溢流的排水沟、堵塞的出水口以及脆弱的防水板或墙壁连接处都会改变水进入的位置。建筑物内的污渍并不总是位于入口点的正下方。在安排屋顶渗漏评估之前，记录天气、受影响的房间和任何安全的外部照片。

屋顶涂漆与防水系统的区别

屋顶涂料不能自动修复失效的泛水板、穿出部位或防水层。我们结合现有屋面构造及已确认的进水路径确定范围。如屋面覆盖物维修需要持牌屋面工，报价会将其与 Ellis 团队的防水工作分别列明。

屋面防水范围

书面报价列明安全进场设备、需处理的防水层或接缝、基层准备，以及单独的屋面或排水任务。天气及屋面状况可能影响可施工时间。

  • 在可安全接近的范围内，结合漏水时间检查屋面、穿出部位、泛水板及相邻墙面接缝。
  • 确定商定的路径是否是局部屋顶修复、膜细节或相关排水工程。
  • 在工作开始前，Ellis团队的防水工作以及任何单独许可的屋顶或排水任务有明确的书面范围。

屋面防水的进场、基层处理与天气条件

  1. 描述受影响的房间、降雨情况以及溢流排水沟或排水口的任何地面观察结果。
  2. 让团队安排安全通道并对相关屋顶细节进行现场评估。
  3. 同意书面报价、天气窗口、薄膜修复边界和任何协调的屋顶工作。

艾萨克斯屋顶防水范围 →

请求屋顶渗漏评估

请求一个 现场评估并书面报价，或致电 0482 422 607。照片是可选的：将安全拍摄的照片通过电子邮件发送至 riley@melonemaintenance.com.au 或在没有照片的情况下联系我们。

记录屋顶漏水现象时请留在地面，远离下垂的天花板和电气装置附近的水。正在进水或存在电气危险时，应及时寻求相应专业协助。

外部防水和进水维修

探索相关的 MEL ONE 防水服务。

防水或排水指南

请阅读适用于业主的相关 MEL ONE 指南。

Woden Valley艾萨克斯的屋顶防水：2026 年 4 月

2026 年 4 月，Ellis团队完成了Woden Valley艾萨克斯一处房产的屋顶防水工作。该工作涵盖了烟囱周围的屋顶细节、通风口和屋檐排水口。这些细节是项目范围的一部分，而不仅仅是屋顶涂漆。

防水基材准备

我们的基层修复顺序是清洁、修补、找平，再施工所选防水材料。按约定系统，屋面工作可能包括铺设防水卷材、涂刷阻隔涂层及用适用密封胶处理接缝。材料按现场选用；这些工序不等同于瓷砖重新填缝。

屋顶膜和防潮层具有不同的作用。片状膜需要合适的接缝和端接；暴露系统必须指定其条件。作为制造商的例子， 亚地斯 WPM 185 是暴露膜系统的盖板，而 亚地斯 WPM 300 是一种环氧底漆/隔离涂层。这些示例解释了区别，而不是 Isaacs 项目中使用的产品。

pages.summary: We replace deteriorated shower grout and silicone when the problem is confined to suitable surface joints. If the waterproofing beneath the tiles has failed, we explain the separate membrane repair needed.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Shower Resealing & Regrouting in Canberra

We replace deteriorated shower grout and silicone when the problem is confined to suitable surface joints. If the waterproofing beneath the tiles has failed, we explain the separate membrane repair needed.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

10+ years of waterproofing experience. Trusted by 10,000+ customers across Australia for property maintenance and repair services. For urgent jobs in Canberra, the Ellis team can be on site in as little as 30 minutes after contact. Arrival timing depends on current availability, the address and safe access.

Shower screen leaks and resealing assessment

A local screen-perimeter repair may be suitable if assessment identifies an accessible failed joint as the water path. Tell us whether water first appears at the screen base, beside the door or outside a tiled corner. The screen arrangement and its drainage details need consideration before deciding which joints should be sealed. Adding silicone wherever water is visible can miss the actual entry point.

Old silicone removal before joint resealing

We check the joint and bonding surfaces, then identify the failed material to remove and the preparation needed for the replacement sealant. Our scope lists the shower-screen edges or tiled junctions being repaired and the surrounding surfaces to retain. Loose grout, damaged tiles or movement may change the work needed.

Silicone repair and concealed membrane failure

Silicone is a joint sealant; it does not replace the membrane beneath tiled finishes. If moisture continues beyond the shower or returns after a surface repair, use the leaking shower assessment service to review the cause. The repair options guide explains when grout, sealant or broader waterproofing work may be relevant. Describe the affected joints before choosing a repair.

Shower grout and silicone repair suitability

We check missing grout between tiles, split silicone at changes of plane, screen junctions and signs of tile movement. Old silicone, residue and damp joint surfaces affect preparation and the bond of the replacement sealant.

Grout fills tile joints; flexible sealant serves movement joints. Neither treatment repairs a concealed membrane failure or a plumbing leak. Persistent moisture after a previous surface repair needs reassessment before more grout or silicone is applied.

Grout and silicone repair scope

Our quote identifies the joints being treated, grout removal depth, preparation and replacement materials. If we find loose tiles or a damaged substrate, we explain the separate repairs needed before regrouting.

  • Inspection of grout, silicone, screen edges and other accessible shower junctions.
  • Removal of failed sealant or grout from the defined repair area.
  • New grout, silicone and agreed finishing work, or a clear recommendation when broader waterproofing is required.

Shower joint preparation, curing and reuse

  1. Identify the worn grout or silicone joints and describe any leak that continued after earlier repairs.
  2. Agree removal of old silicone or deteriorated grout, cleaning and drying before the selected repair.
  3. Keep the shower out of use for the specified preparation and curing periods, then follow the written handover instructions.

Tile regrouting and epoxy grout

MEL ONE also regrouts tiled floors outside the bathroom. Tell us which room needs attention and whether the problem is worn grout, loose tiles or a leak. The quote identifies the area, old grout removal, preparation and replacement grout.

Epoxy regrouting is available where suitable for the tiles and conditions. Our epoxy versus cement grout explanation helps you compare materials. For outdoor tiled areas, see standalone balcony regrouting and waterproofing.

Tile joint repair photographs →

Book MEL ONE waterproofing

Request shower joint repairs

Request an on-site assessment and written quote, or call 0482 422 607. Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to riley@melonemaintenance.com.au or contact us without them.

Clear toiletries and keep the shower dry as arranged. Allow access along screen edges and wall-to-floor junctions without removing fixtures yourself.

Grout, sealant and bond breakers are not interchangeable

Grout fills appropriate fixed tile joints. Flexible sealants and bond breakers form part of specified movement-joint or membrane details; they are not substitutes for grout across a tiled floor. Product compatibility and the condition found on site determine the choice. See tile regrouting and epoxy grout options for tiled areas beyond the shower, or the Sika waterproofing guidance for the role of bond breakers.

pages.title: 堪培拉的淋浴重新密封和重新填缝
pages.summary: 当问题局限于适合表面维修的接缝时，我们更换淋浴间老化的填缝剂和密封胶；若瓷砖下方防水层失效，我们会说明另外需要进行的防水层维修。
pages.body_html:
Ellis团队·MEL ONE防水

堪培拉的淋浴重新密封和重新填缝

当问题局限于适合表面维修的接缝时，我们更换淋浴间老化的填缝剂和密封胶；若瓷砖下方防水层失效，我们会说明另外需要进行的防水层维修。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

10年以上防水经验。 全澳超过10,000位客户信赖我们的物业维护与维修服务。堪培拉紧急工作，Ellis 团队联系后最快30分钟到场；具体时间取决于当前可安排情况、地址和安全进场条件。

淋浴屏泄漏和重新密封评估

如检查确认漏水来自可接触的屏风周边接缝，局部重新密封可能适用。请说明水最先出现在淋浴屏风底部、门边还是瓷砖转角外。我们结合屏风构造与排水细节，确定需要密封的接缝；只在见水处加胶，可能漏掉真正的进水点。

重新密封接头之前去除旧硅胶

我们检查接缝及粘接表面，明确需要清除的失效材料和更换密封胶前的准备工作。施工范围列明需维修的淋浴屏风边缘或瓷砖接缝，以及保留的周边饰面。填缝松动、瓷砖损坏或位移可能影响所需工作。

硅胶修复和隐蔽膜失效

硅酮密封胶用于接缝，不能替代瓷砖下防水层。如潮湿超出淋浴区，或表面维修后再次出现，请通过 淋浴漏水评估服务 检查原因。 维修选项指南 说明填缝、密封胶维修与更广泛防水工作的适用情况。 说明需要维修的接缝 ，再确认维修方法。

淋浴填缝和硅胶修复适用性

我们检查瓷砖填缝缺失、转角处密封胶开裂、淋浴屏风接缝及瓷砖位移迹象。旧胶、残留物和潮湿表面会影响准备工作及新密封胶的粘接。

瓷砖接缝处填满水泥基填缝剂；柔性密封剂用于伸缩接缝。这两种处理方法都无法修复隐藏的膜故障或管道泄漏。先前的表面修复后的持续潮湿需要在涂抹更多的水泥基填缝剂或硅酮密封胶之前重新评估。

填缝和硅胶修复范围

我们的报价列明处理的接缝、旧填缝剂清除深度、准备工作及替换材料。若发现瓷砖松动或基层受损，我们会说明重新填缝前所需的单独维修。

  • 检查填缝剂、密封胶、淋浴屏风边缘及其他可接触的淋浴间接缝。
  • 从指定的维修区域清除失效的密封剂或水泥基填缝剂。
  • 新的填缝、硅胶和商定的饰面工作，或者在需要更广泛的防水时的明确建议。

淋浴接缝处理、固化与恢复使用

  1. 识别磨损的水泥基填缝剂或硅胶接头，并描述早期维修后继续存在的任何泄漏。
  2. 同意在选定的修复之前去除旧的硅胶或变质的水泥基填缝剂，进行清洁和干燥。
  3. 在指定的准备和养护期内不要使用淋浴器，然后按照书面的移交说明进行操作。

瓷砖重新填缝与环氧填缝

我们也为浴室以外的铺砖地面提供重新填缝。请说明房间，以及是填缝磨损、瓷砖松动还是漏水；报价会列明施工区域、旧填缝剂清除、准备工作和替换材料。

在适合瓷砖和条件的情况下，可以使用环氧树脂重新填缝。我们的 环氧树脂与水泥填缝的解释 帮助您比较材料。对于室外瓷砖区域，请参阅 独立阳台重新填缝和防水.

瓷砖接缝修复照片→

预约MEL ONE防水

申请淋浴间接缝维修

请求一个 现场评估并书面报价，或致电 0482 422 607。照片是可选的：将安全拍摄的照片通过电子邮件发送至 riley@melonemaintenance.com.au 或在没有照片的情况下联系我们。

请移开洗漱用品，并按约定让淋浴间保持干燥，留出检查屏风边缘和墙地接缝的空间；不要自行拆卸配件。

淋浴漏水维修

探索相关的 MEL ONE 防水服务。

浴室防水与重新铺砖

探索相关的 MEL ONE 防水服务。

填缝剂、密封胶与防水层隔离材料的用途区别

水泥基填缝剂填充适当的固定瓷砖接缝。柔性密封剂和防水层隔离材料构成指定伸缩接缝或膜细节的一部分；它们不能替代瓷砖地板上的水泥基填缝剂。产品兼容性和现场情况决定了选择。参见 瓷砖重新填缝和环氧填缝选项 对于淋浴间以外的瓷砖区域，或 西卡防水指导 对于防水层隔离材料的作用。

淋浴接缝维修指南与施工照片

了解维修选择，查看相关施工记录，再与我们确认适合您房产的工作。

  • 淋浴填缝、密封与防水层指南

pages.summary: We replace worn or damaged tile grout in bathrooms and other tiled areas. We discuss cement-based grout, epoxy grout and flexible joint resealing to suit the tiles, joint condition and use of the space.
pages.body_html:
Ellis team · MEL ONE waterproofing

Tile Regrouting in Canberra

We replace worn or damaged tile grout in bathrooms and other tiled areas. We discuss cement-based grout, epoxy grout and flexible joint resealing to suit the tiles, joint condition and use of the space.

Request assessmentCall 0482 422 607

Tile grout and movement joint repair assessment

Missing grout between tiles, a split seal at a wall edge and a leak through the membrane are different problems. Tell us whether the concern is worn grout, stained joints, loose tiles or water appearing in another room. That helps define whether you need tile regrouting, joint resealing or a waterproofing assessment.

We regrout tiled floors outside bathrooms as well as showers and balconies. For a shower screen or shower perimeter, start with shower resealing and regrouting. For an outdoor tiled area with ponding or leakage below, see balcony waterproofing.

Tile grout and joint sealing material selection

Cement-based grout, epoxy grout and flexible sealants serve different purposes. Epoxy grout may suit a stain-prone tiled area, but it does not repair a failed membrane beneath tiles. We select materials for the tile finish, joint dimensions, location and condition found on site, and identify them in your quote.

Sealant is used for appropriate flexible joints. A bond breaker controls adhesion within a specified joint or membrane detail so movement can be accommodated; it is not tile grout. An epoxy moisture-barrier coating is also not epoxy grout. Read our guide to regrouting, resealing and membrane replacement before choosing a repair based only on the word “epoxy”.

Regrouting suitability and concealed leak limitations

A local grout or seal repair may be appropriate where the defect is limited to that joint. Recurring dampness after resealing, loose tiles or water reaching the room below needs further assessment. Regrouting the surface does not replace a concealed waterproofing membrane or repair damaged backing.

Tile regrouting quote factors

Share the suburb, approximate tiled area, indoor or outdoor location, tile type and the condition of the joints. Mention any previous repairs and whether water is escaping. Access, preparation, joint condition, selected materials and any separate tile or membrane work affect the scope. We do not assume that new grout alone will resolve an unexplained leak.

Photos are optional. Send a wide view and a close-up of the affected joints if safely accessible, or arrange a site visit without them. Our written quote distinguishes fixed tile joints from movement joints and identifies any work outside the grout repair.

Tile regrouting: before and after

The same tiled area before and after joint repair.

Tell us the property address and access arrangements when requesting a quote. Site conditions determine the repair scope and suitable materials.

We complete an on-site assessment and confirm the agreed work and written quote before starting.

我们为浴室及其他铺砖区域更换磨损或损坏的填缝剂，并根据瓷砖、接缝状况和空间用途，说明水泥基填缝、环氧填缝及柔性接缝密封的适用选择。

预约现场评估致电 0482 422 607

瓷砖填缝和移动接缝修复评估

瓷砖填缝缺失、墙边密封胶开裂和防水层漏水是不同问题。请说明是填缝磨损、接缝污渍、瓷砖松动，还是水出现在另一房间，以便判断需要重新填缝、接缝密封或防水评估。

我们为浴室以外的铺砖地面，以及淋浴间和阳台提供重新填缝服务。若涉及淋浴屏风或周边接缝，请先查看 淋浴重新密封和重新填缝。室外铺砖区域如有积水或楼下渗漏，请查看 阳台防水.

瓷砖填缝剂和接缝密封材料的选择

水泥基填缝剂、环氧填缝剂和柔性密封胶用途不同。环氧填缝剂可能适合易沾污的铺砖区域，但不能修复瓷砖下方失效的防水层。我们根据瓷砖饰面、接缝尺寸、位置和现场状况选择材料，并在报价中列明。

密封剂用于适当的柔性接头。防水层隔离材料控制指定接头或膜细节内的粘附力，以便可以适应运动；它不是瓷砖填缝。环氧防潮涂层也不是环氧填缝。阅读我们的 重新填缝、重新密封和膜更换指南 在仅根据“环氧树脂”一词选择修复之前。

重新填缝的适用条件与隐蔽漏水限制

若缺陷仅限于指定接缝，局部填缝或密封维修可能适用。重新密封后仍反复潮湿、瓷砖松动或楼下受潮，需要进一步检查。表面重新填缝不能替代隐蔽防水层，也不能修复受损基层。

瓷砖重新填缝报价因素

分享郊区、大概的瓷砖面积、室内或室外位置、瓷砖类型和接缝状况。提及之前的任何维修以及是否漏水。通道、准备工作、接缝条件、所选材料以及任何单独的瓷砖或膜工作都会影响范围。我们并不认为仅使用新的水泥基填缝剂就能解决不明原因的泄漏问题。

照片并非必需。如能安全拍摄，可提供整体照片和问题接缝的特写；也可以直接安排现场评估。我们的书面报价区分固定瓷砖接缝与伸缩接缝，并列明填缝维修以外的工作。

同一铺砖区域在接缝维修前后的照片。
